ATemptingTrap.description: Sho'Syl receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from all attacks, but loses {[hp]} Health each time he is damaged by a melee attack. At the start of his third turn, he summons {[nrOfSummons]} Stealth Battlesuits plus an additional Battlesuit for each enemy unit on the battlefield. The summoned units immediately take a turn. Stealth Battlesuit stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ATemptingTrap.name: A Tempting Trap

AberrantHypermorph.description: Summons an Aberrant Hypermorph in a free adjacent hex. The Aberrant Hypermorph can immediately attack, but cannot move this turn. Aberrant Hypermorph's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
AberrantHypermorph.name: Aberrant Hypermorph

AblativePlating.description: Any incoming Damage with less than {[pierceRatio]}% Pierce Ratio must go through Armour three times. Does not apply to Crits.
AblativePlating.name: Ablative Plating

AdaptiveStrategy.description: Triggers Relentless March again for all adjacent Non-Character friendly units and makes them immediately take an action, dealing {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Damage per hit if they attack.
AdaptiveStrategy.name: Adaptive Strategy

AdaptiveToxins.description: Each unit hit by the Hive Tyrant in melee suffers a -{[armorReduction]} Armour reduction for the rest of the battle.
AdaptiveToxins.name: Adaptive Toxins

AdrenalGlands.description: May move with +{[extraMovement]} Movement if that move ends in a hex adjacent to an enemy
AdrenalGlands.name: Adrenal Glands

AdrenalSurge.description: Each time the Screamer-Killer defeats an enemy, it gains +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance until the end of the battle.
AdrenalSurge.name: Adrenal Surge

AetherStride.description: Summons Z'Kar as a stationary unit in a 3 hex area on the battlefield. If he is summoned adjacent to a friendly Psyker, he immediately performs a normal attack against a target in range. When Z'Kar is defeated or leaves the battlefield via his Hunter of Souls battlefield ability, he returns as Machine of War. Z'Kar Stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
AetherStride.name: Aether Stride

AggressiveOnslaught.description: When charging, Mataneo summons {[nrOfSummons]} Jump Pack Intercessors adjacent to and immediately attacking his target. At the beginning of each of Mataneo's turns, if he is still on the battlefield, all Jump Pack Intercessors summoned this way leave the battlefield. Jump Pack Intercessor stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
AggressiveOnslaught.name: Aggressive Onslaught

AllIsDust.description: Attacks against this unit with {[pierceRatio]}% pierce ratio or less are treated as having a 1% pierce ratio.
AllIsDust.name: All is Dust

AlphaWarrior.description: If the Winged Prime has not moved this turn, summons a Tyranid Warrior on a free hex within Synapse range. The Tyranid Warrior cannot move this turn, but can immediately perform a normal attack against an enemy in range. Tyranid Warrior stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
AlphaWarrior.name: Alpha Warrior

AmuletOfTheVoidwyrm.description: The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each friendly adjacent Summon or Decoy.
AmuletOfTheVoidwyrm.name: Amulet of the Voidwyrm

AncestralFortune.description: Ûthar gains +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and +{[extraBlockChance]}% Block chance until the start of his next turn. If he is adjacent to an enemy unit, he immediately performs an attack, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma. After a combined total of {[nrOfAttacks]} attacks that Ûthar has Blocked or scored Crits in after using Ancestral Fortune, the ability can be used again.
AncestralFortune.name: Ancestral Fortune

AncientFury.description: Normal melee attacks also deal damage to each enemy that is adjacent to both the target and Galatian. Normal ranged attacks also deal damage to each enemy that is both adjacent to the target and exactly 2 hexes away from Galatian.
AncientFury.name: Ancient Fury

AnnihilatorBeam.description: Szarekh triggers his Triarchal Menhirs to fire on {[nrOfTargets]} hexes. These hexes light up with light pillars and at the start of Szarekh's next turn any unit in those hexes is dealt {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage.
AnnihilatorBeam.name: Annihilator Beam

AnvilShield.description: Arjac blocks an additional {[blockDmg]} Damage and when he Blocks he covers the attacker's hex in Ice. If Arjac is below {[healthPct]}% Health, or if his attacker is on a hex covered in Ice, he gains +{[blockChance]}% Block chance and if he blocks a melee attack, the attacker is Stunned until the end of the attacker's next turn.
AnvilShield.name: Anvil Shield

ArcScourge.description: Attacks an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. Up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional units adjacent to each other are also hit, including friendly units. Enemy units that are hit receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage and if they are Mechanical, they are also Stunned for 1 round. For each mechanical unit hit, Belisarius Cawl gains {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance. After using Arc Scourge, Belisarius Cawl can immediately use another action.
ArcScourge.name: Arc Scourge

ArcaneShield.description: After moving, Thaumachus applies a Shield to the closest friendly unit within {[range]} hexes, preferring Thousand Sons units, then other Chaos units, then other friendly units, and lastly casting it on himself if there is no other valid target. The shield has {[shieldHp]} Health and lasts one round. If Thaumachus does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
ArcaneShield.name: Arcane Shield

ArchContaminator.description: At the beginning of his turn all adjacent enemies take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage plus each hit also deals extra Damage equal to {[extraDmgPct]}-{[extraDmgPct_2]}% of the unit's max Health. Summons take double damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ArchContaminator.name: Arch-Contaminator

ArmoriumCherub.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to a target within range {[range]}. Using Armorium Cherub does not end Vindicta's turn.
ArmoriumCherub.name: Armorium Cherub

ArmourOfShriekingSouls.description: If Lucius is defeated by an enemy unit, that enemy becomes Elated. At the beginning of each of its turns, the affected unit loses {[minHp]}-{[maxHp]} Health and when it is defeated or leaves the battlefield, Lucius resurrects on the last hex the enemy was on with a maximum of {[hp]} Health.
ArmourOfShriekingSouls.name: Armour of Shrieking Souls

ArmouredMight.description: This unit’s movement is not blocked by other units, instead they get pushed and take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage. Summons and units that cannot be displaced are automatically defeated, and all units defeated by this ability are always overkilled.
ArmouredMight.name: Armoured Might

AstartesBanner.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes score an additional hit with their melee attacks. This additional hit can deal a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage.
AstartesBanner.name: Astartes Banner

AttemptedPossession.description: Target an enemy within {[range]} hexes. The target and any Summons it has summoned become possessed and immediately perform a normal attack against the closest enemy unit, preferring unpossessed targets. Possessed units deal {[dmgPct]}% of their own Damage to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage per hit. Possessed Summons will move before attacking.
AttemptedPossession.name: Attempted Possession

AugmentedAssault.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate to an adjacent enemy unit and reduces its Armour by {[armorReduction]} Armour for the rest of the battle. Using Augmented Assault does not end Hâvyr's turn.
AugmentedAssault.name: Augmented Assault

AvalancheOfMuscle.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage when charging.
AvalancheOfMuscle.name: Avalanche of Muscle

BarbedOvipositor.description: When the Parasite of Mortrex defeats a unit it targeted that is not Mechanical it summons a Ripper Swarm in the defeated unit's hex. Ripper Swarm stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
BarbedOvipositor.name: Barbed Ovipositor

BasiliskBarrage.description: If Thaddeus Noble has not moved, unleashes a barrage of {[nrOfProjectiles]} shells on any target on the battlefield, each dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage. {[nrOfProjectiles_2]} randomly hit the target hex or surrounding hexes and the remaining 2 hit the hexes surrounding those. For each round that has ended, 1 more of the shells hits the target hex, starting with the shells hitting the outer hexes. The Suppressive Fire trait applies also to this ability. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
BasiliskBarrage.name: Basilisk Barrage

BattleFocus.description: After attacking or being attacked, moves 1 hex in a direction as far away from enemies as possible.
BattleFocus.name: Battle Focus

BeaconOfRage.description: For each time he was attacked in battle, up to a maximum of {[nrOfAttacks]} times, Azkor deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage. If Azkor has defeated an enemy in this battle, 50% of the extra damage granted by Beacon of Rage is added to the damage of melee attacks of adjacent friendly Chaos units.
BeaconOfRage.name: Beacon Of Rage

BigBadaBoomReworked.description: Explodes when destroyed, damaging units on adjacent hexes. Tanksmasha loses {[hp]} Health from the explosion and all other characters take {[nrOfHits]} hit that inflicts Blast Damage equal to {[dmgPct]}% of the character's maximum Health. All affected Summons are destroyed.
BigBadaBoomReworked.name: Big Boom

BioBarrage.description: The Tervigon itself and all friendly units deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% ranged Damage if they did not move in their turn.
BioBarrage.name: Bio Barrage

BioMinefield.description: Targets an enemy on the battlefield. If there are {[nrOfSummons]} or more Spore Mines on the battlefield, all Spore Mines immediately take a turn, moving towards the target, if possible. Otherwise, summon {[nrOfSummons_2]} Spore Mines in free hexes adjacent to the target. Spore Mines have {[summonHp]} Health and deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage with Floating Death. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} rounds. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
BioMinefield.name: Bio-Minefield

BlackRage.description: If Lucien has not moved, he is set to {[hpPct]}% Health. He then immediately charges a targeted enemy in movement range and performs a normal melee attack against it. For this attack and until the end of the battle, Lucien has +{[extraMovement]} Movement and deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage when charging. Additionally, Lucien can no longer be controlled for the rest of the battle, and moves and attacks automatically at the beginning of his turn instead.
BlackRage.name: Black Rage

BladeOfMagnus.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target enemy within 2 hexes and all enemies adjacent to it. This damage is increased by +{[extraDmg]} Damage if the affected units are on Fire hexes.
BladeOfMagnus.name: Blade of Magnus

BladeOfTheAncestors.description: Ûthar gains +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage each time a friendly character dies or kills an enemy unit. Once Ûthar crits, this bonus resets.
BladeOfTheAncestors.name: Blade of the Ancestors

BlightGrenades.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]} that is not on a hex with Contamination, and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability benefits from Indirect Fire. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
BlightGrenades.name: Blight Grenades

BlightedLand.description: Friendly Mythic characters deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage while on a Contaminated hex.
BlightedLand.name: Blighted Land

BlisteringAssault.description: The Screamer-Killer's normal attacks also affect all enemies adjacent to the target of the attack.
BlisteringAssault.name: Blistering Assault

BloodChalice.description: All adjacent friendly non-mechanical units are set to {[healthPct]}% Health. Until the start of their next turn, affected units gain +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with melee attacks and heal for {[hpToHeal]} Health if they perform a melee attack.
BloodChalice.name: Blood Chalice

BloodRunsAngerRisesWarCallsReworked.description: At the end of the Avatar of Khaine's turn, if there are less than {[nrOfUnits]} Guardian Defenders on the battlefield, he summons 2 Guardian Defenders at one of the battlefield corners. Guardian Defender stats {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
BloodRunsAngerRisesWarCallsReworked.name: Blood Runs! Anger Rises! War Calls!

BloodyFury.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Chain Damage to an adjacent enemy. This attack scores +{[extraHit]} hit for each time Wrask was attacked in this battle, to a maximum of {[maxNrOfHits]} hits total. Any leftover hits are allocated to remaining adjacent enemies, prioritising kills.
BloodyFury.name: Bloody Fury

Boltstorm.description: Normal ranged attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to the target and to each enemy adjacent to the target that is also within range of Brother Burchard. Enemies hit are Suppressed for 1 round.
Boltstorm.name: Boltstorm

BookOfFate.description: After the relic bearer performs a normal attack, a friendly adjacent Summon performs a normal attack against an enemy in range, if possible. If the summon is a Daemon, it deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage with this attack.
BookOfFate.name: Book of Fate

BossAdjutant.description: This unit takes -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage. Each time this unit is dealt damage, up to {[nrOfAttacks]} times per turn, it loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done.
BossAdjutant.name: Boss Adjutant

Bounce.description: After being attacked, has a {[chance]}% chance to be thrown to a new position within 2 hexes. If that hex is occupied, the Large Squig deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to the unit on that hex and pushes it to a random free adjacent hex. This ability can also trigger if the Large Squig is killed by an attack, unless Overkilled.
Bounce.name: Bounce

BrazierOfHolyFire.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to a target enemy within range {[range]} and sets its hex on Fire. Deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage vs Daemons instead. ALL Daemons within {[range_2]} hexes of the target take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Extra Damage this round and the next. Immune Daemons only take +{[extraDmgPct_2]}% Extra Damage.
BrazierOfHolyFire.name: Brazier of Holy Fire

BreathOfSilence.description: Szarekh summons {[nrOfSummons]} Deathmarks on free hexes within range {[range]} from his throne starting hex.
BreathOfSilence.name: Breath of Silence

BringerOfDespair.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to a melee target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to another random enemy adjacent to Angrax. Any resulting Battle Fatigue is triggered twice.
BringerOfDespair.name: Bringer of Despair

BroodProgenitor.description: Termagants in adjacent hexes deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage in their ranged attacks
BroodProgenitor.name: Brood Progenitor

Burrowers.description: This unit may burrow in its turn, disappearing from the battlefield. In its following turn it must surface and may do so in any free hex. If adjacent to an enemy unit, it may attack in melee immediately.
Burrowers.name: Burrowers

CabalOfSorcerers.description: Friendly Mythic Psyker characters deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage if they are adjacent to Z'Kar or adjacent to another friendly Mythic Psyker character.
CabalOfSorcerers.name: Cabal of Sorcerers

CalibaniteGreatsword.description: Forcas can switch between two stances. Strike Stance: At the end of his turn, Forcas starts Overwatching, even if he attacked in his turn. When defeating a unit while Overwatching, he remains in Overwatch, retaining {[nrOfHits]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack. Sweep Stance: Forcas' normal attacks also deal {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to each enemy adjacent to both Forcas and the initial target. This ability can be used once per turn; each use switches the active Stance and does not end Forcas' turn. Only the first use of this ability in each battle counts as using an active ability.
CalibaniteGreatsword.name: Calibanite Greatsword

CallInReinforcements.description: At the end of the Vox-caster’s action, a Cadian Guardsman is summoned in a nearby free edge hex and immediately takes a turn. Cadian Guardsman’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallInReinforcements.name: Call In Reinforcements

CallRipperSwarms.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} burrowing Ripper Swarms, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit Ripper Swarms' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallRipperSwarms.name: Call Ripper Swarms

CallRipperSwarms2.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} burrowing Ripper Swarms, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit Ripper Swarms' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallRipperSwarms2.name: Call Ripper Swarms

CallRipperSwarms3.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} burrowing Ripper Swarms, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit Ripper Swarms' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallRipperSwarms3.name: Call Ripper Swarms

CamoCloak.description: Whenever an incoming ranged attack has its number of hits reduced for any reason, it deals -{[dmgReduction]} Damage per hit to this unit.
CamoCloak.name: Camo Cloak

Catalyst.description: All friendly Tyranid units get +{[extraArmor]} Armour and a {[blockChance]}% chance to Block {[blockDmg]} Damage for the rest of this turn and the coming enemy turn.
Catalyst.name: Catalyst

ChaliceOfBaal.description: The first time each turn that any unit adjacent to Nicodemus dies, he heals himself and all friendly adjacent units for {[hp]} Health. All affected units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with normal melee attacks until the end of this turn.
ChaliceOfBaal.name: Chalice of Baal

ChampionOfTheFeast.description: After moving, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy and reduces this enemy's Armour by {[armorReduction]} Armour for the rest of the battle. If Sword Brother Godswyl does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
ChampionOfTheFeast.name: Champion Of The Feast

Chronometron.description: All enemy units within range {[range]} are Suppressed for {[nrOfRounds]} round. Affected Summons are Stunned instead. All affected enemies take +{[extraDmg]} Damage from the next attack made by a unit against them, or +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage if the attacker is Mechanical.
Chronometron.name: Chronometron

CloudOfFlies.description: Receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage while on a hex with Contamination. If this unit is attacked while it is not on a hex with Contamination, it has a {[chance]}% chance to contaminate the hex it is standing on.
CloudOfFlies.name: Cloud Of Flies

CombatRestoratives.description: Heals himself and all adjacent friendly units for {[hpToHeal]} Health. {[hpToHeal_2]} Health if Imperial.
CombatRestoratives.name: Combat Restoratives

Conceal.description: Aeldari units within {[range]} hexes ignore their Battle Fatigue trait, if they have it, and are treated as having the Camouflage trait.
Conceal.name: Conceal

CondemnorStake.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage against Psykers.
CondemnorStake.name: Condemnor Stake

ContemptuousDisregard.description: Friendly Mythic characters take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage while on a hex with a hex effect.
ContemptuousDisregard.name: Contemptuous Disregard

ControlEdict.description: While Protector Imperative is active: After Tan Gi’da attacks, summon a Skitarii Vanguard in a free adjacent hex. Cannot have more than {[maxSummons]} Skitarii Vanguards summoned this way at the same time. While Conqueror Imperative is active: After Tan Gi’da attacks, all friendly adjacent Mechanical Summons also immediately attack his target if it is within range. Skitarii Vanguard stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ControlEdict.name: Control Edict

CordClaw.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to an adjacent enemy. All of Exitor-Rho’s further attacks until the end of its next turn deal an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage.
CordClaw.name: Chordclaw

CosmicHorror.description: Whenever the Patermine defeats an enemy, it places a decoy on the hex of that enemy. Other enemies surrounding the defeated unit have a {[chance]}% chance to be Suppressed for 1 round, and have a {[chance]}% chance to trigger Battle Fatigue a second time, if they have it. When the Patermine moves onto a decoy, it heals itself for {[hp]} Health.
CosmicHorror.name: Cosmic Horror

CrazedFocus.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage to enemies on hexes with a hex effect.
CrazedFocus.name: Crazed Focus

CrusadeOfWrath.description: All other friendly units within {[range]} hexes gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage and +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio in melee – regardless of Damage type – for this round and the next. High Marshal Helbrecht immediately performs a normal melee attack against a random adjacent enemy.
CrusadeOfWrath.name: Crusade Of Wrath

CrushingClaws.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy and Taunts them for 1 round. Enemies adjacent to both the Tyrant Guard and the target take {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage and then get pushed back 1 hex. All affected units become Suppressed for 1 round.
CrushingClaws.name: Crushing Claws

CultDemagogue.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes and places decoys on up to {[nrOfSummons]} random free hexes within {[range_2]} hexes around the target. Then summons Neophyte Hybrids on half of all the friendly decoys in that area and all Neophyte Hybrids in that area immediately take a turn. Neophyte Hybrid stats: {[summonHp_2]} Health {[summonDmg_2]} Damage {[summonArmor_2]} Armour
CultDemagogue.name: Cult Demagogue

CursedOfTheWalkingPox.description: Each time this unit kills an enemy non-Mechanical unit, a Poxwalker is summoned in that hex.
CursedOfTheWalkingPox.name: Cursed of The Walking Pox

CursedPlagueBell.description: Friendly Chaos units starting their turn within Corrodius' Contagion aura gain +{[extraMovement]} Movement for this turn. Enemy Psyker units within Corrodius' Contagion aura deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Psychic Damage to themselves each time one of their attacks deals Psychic Damage.
CursedPlagueBell.name: Cursed Plague Bell

CyclicIonBlaster.description: All attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage. If the target has a Markerlight or the Mechanical trait these hits deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage.
CyclicIonBlaster.name: Cyclic Ion Blaster

DaBossIsWatchin.description: Adjacent Orks ignore Battle Fatigue and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
DaBossIsWatchin.name: Da Boss Is Watchin'

DaGreatWaaagh.description: Ghazghkull summons {[nrOfSummons_2]} Stormboy for each enemy on the map plus {[nrOfSummons]} additional Ork Boyz, who appear on free hexes near the top of the map. Then each Ork takes a normal turn, gaining +{[extraMovement]} Movement and +{[extraHit]} hit on their melee attacks this turn.
DaGreatWaaagh.name: Da Great Waaagh!

DaRevolushun.description: Whenever an adjacent unit is defeated, Da Red Gobbo summons a Grot in its hex, unless the defeated unit was a Grot. The summoned Grot can immediately attack an adjacent enemy. Whenever a friendly Grot is defeated anywhere on the battlefield, it explodes and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all adjacent Grots and all adjacent enemies. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DaRevolushun.name: Da Revolushun!

DaemonfleshPlate.description: Each time the relic bearer attacks, it gains +{[extraArmor]} Armour. After attacking {[nrOfAttacks]} times, this bonus is reset and the relic bearer can use its active ability again.
DaemonfleshPlate.name: Daemonflesh Plate

DaemonicOrdnance.description: Sets a target hex and the two hexes behind it on Fire. If one of these hexes is already on fire, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to enemies on it. Can deal {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. The Forgefiend's Crit Chance for both its abilities is increased by {[extraCritChance]}% for each time Daemonic Ordnance is used during a battle, but after the Forgefiend causes {[nrOfHits_2]} or more critical hits during its turn, it cannot cause any critical hits anymore for the remainder of the battle. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
DaemonicOrdnance.name: Daemonic Ordnance

DaemonicPatrons.description: Taunts an adjacent enemy, and Hascule gets watched until the end of his next turn. While being watched, Hascule deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage and takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage for each adjacent Taunted enemy. If he defeats an adjacent Taunted enemy while being watched, he can use this ability again. If he does not, he loses {[hpPct]}% of his current Health.
DaemonicPatrons.name: Daemonic Patrons

DakkaDakkaDakka.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds +{[extraHits]} hits for each time Snappawrecka was repaired this battle, but cannot exceed {[maxNrOfHits]} hits in total. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to random enemies within {[range_2]} hexes. Snappawrecka also loses {[healthPct]}% of his maximum Health.
DakkaDakkaDakka.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!

DarkTalonStrike.description: Azrael calls in a Ravenwing Dark Talon to deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to a target enemy within {[range]} hexes and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Bolter Damage to all enemies in an uninterrupted straight line originating from the initial target. All enemies hit are Suppressed. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DarkTalonStrike.name: Dark Talon Strike

DaughterOfTheAbyss.description: Atlacoya takes -{[dmgReduction]} Psychic Damage. Psychic Damage dealt to other friendly units within {[range]} hexes of Atlacoya is reduced by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Enemy Psykers within {[range]} hexes receive +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
DaughterOfTheAbyss.name: Daughter Of The Abyss

DawnBlade.description: Commander Farsight's melee attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each time another friendly Character within {[range]} hexes has performed a ranged attack this turn. When Commander Farsight kills an enemy unit with a melee attack, he repairs himself for {[hpToHeal]} Health.
DawnBlade.name: Dawn Blade

DeathFromAbove.description: Summons 1 Inceptor for each round that has started. The Inceptors land adjacent to the target, whom they attack immediately. Note: if not enough hexes around the target are free, fewer Inceptors will be summoned. Inceptor stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
DeathFromAbove.name: Death From Above

DeathOnTheWind.description: Targets an enemy unit that was already attacked this turn. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} HeavyRound to all enemies on a straight line {[nrOfTiles]} hexes long, starting on the hex of the targeted enemy. Affected enemies take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from the next attack by a friendly Dark Angel this turn. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DeathOnTheWind.name: Death on the Wind

DeathScream.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Plasma Damage to a target enemy within range {[range]} and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[dmg_2]} Bio Damage to all enemies adjacent to the target. {[stunChance]}% chance to Stun all affected units for 1 round.
DeathScream.name: Death Scream

Deathwing.description: Each time Baraqiel blocks damage during an attack, all further incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReduction]} and the damage Baraqiel deals with melee or Plasma Cannon attacks is increased by {[extraDmg]} for 1 round. This effect is doubled against Chaos enemies or when standing adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel.
Deathwing.name: Deathwing

DeathwingKnight.description: Each time the Deathwing Knight blocks damage during an attack, all further incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReduction]} and the damage he deals is increased by {[extraDmg]} for 1 round. This effect is doubled against Chaos enemies or when standing adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel.
DeathwingKnight.name: Deathwing

DecoysAndMisdirection.description: When an enemy moves onto a friendly decoy, it takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage. When a friendly unit resurrects onto or moves onto a friendly decoy, it deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of its turn, and if it is a Genestealer Cults unit, it also places a new decoy in a free adjacent hex.
DecoysAndMisdirection.name: Decoys and Misdirection

DefendTheDivineWork.description: Repairs himself and all friendly adjacent units {[hpToRepair]} Health.
DefendTheDivineWork.name: Defend The Divine Work

DefenderOfTheGreaterGood.description: Friendly units adjacent to Shadowsun or her Command-Link Drone deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. Affected attacks also have a chance to score an additional hit. This chance is {[chance]}% for each round in which Shadowsun has been on the battlefield. Friendly T'au Empire units within 2 hexes of Shadowsun or her Command-Link Drone are also affected by this ability.
DefenderOfTheGreaterGood.name: Defender of the Greater Good

DestroyTheWitch.description: Gains +{[extraMovement]} Movement when there’s an enemy Psyker on the battlefield. This unit and friendly adjacent units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks against Psykers.
DestroyTheWitch.name: Destroy The Witch

DestroyerHive.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to one random adjacent enemy at the start of his turn.
DestroyerHive.name: Destroyer Hive

DevastatingRefrain.description: Marks a hex on the battlefield and 3 additional hexes adjacent to it but not to each other. At the beginning of its next turn, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all enemies on marked hexes. Each enemy unit hit has a {[chance]}% chance to increase the Crit Chance and Crit Damage of friendly units with Act of Faith as if a friendly Imperial unit had killed an enemy unit. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DevastatingRefrain.name: Devastating Refrain

DevoutPush.description: Executes a normal melee attack on a single target, then gets to move 1 additional hex.
DevoutPush.name: Devout Push

DoctrinaImperatives.description: Tan Gi’da switches between two Imperatives that affect him and all friendly adjacent Mechanical units: Protector Imperative: Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Conqueror Imperative: Affected units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against units with reduced Armour. This ability can be used once per turn instead of once per battle; each use switches the active Imperative. Tan Gi’da can attack after using this ability. Only the first use of this ability each battle counts as using an active ability.
DoctrinaImperatives.name: Doctrina Imperatives

Doom.description: All enemy units exactly {[range]} hexes away from Eldryon take +{[extraDmg]} Damage from other friendly unit's normal attacks. Other friendly Aeldari units deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage with all their attacks to affected units instead.
Doom.name: Doom

DoomSiren.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to an adjacent enemy and up to {[nrOfUnits]} other random enemies adjacent to the target. For the rest of the battle, Adamatar's normal attacks score an additional hit for each enemy Overkilled by Doom Siren.
DoomSiren.name: Doom Siren

Doombolt.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage, evenly distributing the hits between all enemies within {[range]} hexes. Adds +1 hit for each hex on the battlefield that is currently on Fire. Cannot exceed 9 hits. When Ahriman defeats an enemy with his normal ranged attack and Doombolt has already been used, then Doombolt can be used again in this battle.
Doombolt.name: Doombolt

Drachnyen.description: Abaddon is set to {[hp]} Health and immediately performs a normal melee attack against an adjacent enemy unit. After this attack and for the rest of the battle, after performing a normal melee attack, Abaddon performs a second attack against an adjacent enemy unit, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage. Abaddon cannot be set to higher Health than his maximum Health.
Drachnyen.name: Drach’nyen

DrawFire.description: Any friendly adjacent units hit by enemy attacks have half of the hits (rounded down) hit the Terminator instead.
DrawFire.name: Draw Fire

DutyEternal.description: Summons Galatian as a stationary unit in a 3 hex area on the battlefield. After using this ability, Galatian can no longer be used as a Machine of War for the rest of the battle. Galatian stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} rounds. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
DutyEternal.name: Duty Eternal

Dw02AdvancedBurstCannon.description: Each time Re'vas attacks, she gains +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio. After attacking {[nrOfAttacks]} times, this bonus is reset, and Re'vas can use her active ability again.
Dw02AdvancedBurstCannon.name: DW-02 Advanced Burst Cannon

EarlyWarningOverride.description: Summons 2 Shield Drones into free adjacent hexes. Newly summoned Shield Drones can immediately attack an enemy in melee, but cannot move this turn. Re'vas also starts Overwatching until the start of her next turn, dealing +{[extraDmg]} Damage. When defeating a unit while Overwatching, she remains in Overwatch, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack. Shield Drones' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
EarlyWarningOverride.name: Early Warning Override

EchoesFromTheWarp.description: When this unit moves, it leaves a time ghost behind on the hex it moved from. The time ghost vanishes if the hex becomes occupied by another unit or if the terrain becomes impassable (as with Broken Ice). The first time this unit dies each battle, if its time ghost is on the battlefield then it revives with Full Health at its location. This works even if this unit is Overkilled.
EchoesFromTheWarp.name: Echoes From the Warp

EcogSupport.description: Whenever Vynn repairs a friendly unit, he summons an E-COG in a free adjacent hex. Cannot have more than {[maxSummons]} E-COGs summoned this way at the same time. Vynn can repair other friendly units even if they are at full Health and if he repairs a friendly unit while {[maxSummons]} summoned E-COGs are already on the battlefield, one random summoned E-COG adjacent to Vynn also performs a repair, if possible. E-COG stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
EcogSupport.name: E-COG-Support

EcstaticSlaughter.description: When Hascule becomes Thrilled or every time an enemy unit adjacent to him is Overkilled, Hascule deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an adjacent enemy unit. If the enemy survives, it is Taunted for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
EcstaticSlaughter.name: Ecstatic Slaughter

ElectroShock.description: When this unit performs a normal melee attack, it also deals {[dmgPct]}% of its Damage to a random enemy adjacent to the target and all damaged enemies are Suppressed for 1 round.
ElectroShock.name: Electro-Shock

ElectrochaffBackups.description: Enemy units that have a Markerlight or have been damaged by a ranged attack deal -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage to Mythic characters for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
ElectrochaffBackups.name: Electrochaff Backups

EmbodiedProphecy.description: During its first {[nrOfRounds]} rounds, the Zephyrim deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage, blocks an additional +{[blockDmg]} Damage and their Block chance is increased by +{[blockChance]}%.
EmbodiedProphecy.name: Embodied Prophecy

EmpyricAmbush.description: Lhykhis moves adjacent to an enemy unit on the battlefield that has a free adjacent hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate to it. Until the end of this turn, attacks against the target of Empyric Ambush made by other friendly characters that are Aeldari or traversed {[movement]} or more hexes this turn have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deal {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. When Lhykhis defeats an enemy with a normal melee attack, and Empyric Ambush has already been used, then Empyric Ambush can be used again in this battle. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
EmpyricAmbush.name: Empyric Ambush

EnmityForTheUnworthy.description: Forcas deals +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage for each adjacent unit and additionally +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each adjacent friendly Dark Angel.
EnmityForTheUnworthy.name: Enmity for the Unworthy

EntropyCannons.description: Targets an enemy unit that has their Armour reduced or is within a friendly Contagion aura. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to the target. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
EntropyCannons.name: Entropy Cannons

EreWeGo.description: Ghazghkull faces in one of 6 directions and prepares to charge out to range {[range]} in front of him. At the start of his next turn he charges along that path, leaving devastation in his wake. Enemy Summons in the path are automatically defeated. Each enemy Character on the path takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage and is Stunned for 1 round. Orks in the path also get Stunned for 1 round but take no Damage. All units defeated by this ability are always overkilled.
EreWeGo.name: 'Ere We Go!

EuphoricStrikes.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy. The next attack against that enemy this turn has +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance. Using Euphoric Strikes does not end Laviscus' turn.
EuphoricStrikes.name: Euphoric Strikes

ExcruciatingFrequencies.description: Affects {[nrOfTiles]} hexes in a straight line in one of 6 directions. This attack has +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance for each unit on affected hexes and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to each enemy on affected hexes. Enemies hit are also Suppressed.
ExcruciatingFrequencies.name: Excruciating Frequencies

Executioner.description: An enemy target within range {[range]} takes {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage for each round that has started. If the target is eliminated, then an adjacent enemy unit also takes {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage for each round that has started.
Executioner.name: Executioner

ExemplarOfHate.description: Targets an enemy on the battlefield. For this round and the next, all friendly units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against that enemy with melee or Overwatch attacks. If that enemy is Chaos, it gets Suppressed and Asmodai or another friendly Dark Angel immediately performs a normal attack against the target, dealing {[dmgPct]}% of its own damage, to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage per hit.
ExemplarOfHate.name: Exemplar of Hate

ExemplarOfTheKauyon.description: Commander Shadowsun disappears, then reappears on a target hex adjacent to an allied unit and immediately performs a normal attack against the closest enemy target. This attack deals an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Blast Damage. A stationary Command-Link Drone is summoned in the hex she previously occupied. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Command-Link Drone stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ExemplarOfTheKauyon.name: Exemplar of the Kauyon

ExemplarOfTheMontka.description: Until the end of this turn, Commander Farsight and all other friendly Characters with a normal ranged attack gain Unstoppable and all their normal attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage. When attacking a Big Target, they deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage instead. Using Exemplar of the Mont'ka does not end Commander Farsight's turn.
ExemplarOfTheMontka.name: Exemplar of the Mont'ka

Explosive.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all adjacent hexes when destroyed. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Explosive.name: Explosive

ExplosiveMaladies.description: Friendly units adjacent to Pestillian deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[extraDmg]} Blast Damage with their normal ranged attacks. Friendly Chaos units adjacent to Pestillian also deal this damage with normal melee attacks. Enemies defeated by affected attacks are always overkilled.
ExplosiveMaladies.name: Explosive Maladies

ExplosivePresents.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to an enemy unit or friendly Grot within range {[range]} and all units adjacent to the target, except Da Red Gobbo itself. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds. This cooldown is reduced by {[cooldownReduction]} round whenever a Grot is defeated. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ExplosivePresents.name: Explosive Presents

FabricatorClawArray.description: After moving, repairs one random adjacent friendly Mechanical unit for {[hpToRepair]} Health. If Aleph-Null does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of its turn.
FabricatorClawArray.name: Fabricator Claw Array

Fealty.description: When Lion El'Jonson performs a normal melee attack, he also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Lion El'Jonson.
Fealty.name: Fealty

FearOfTheUnseen.description: Can only be used if the Deathleaper has not moved this turn. All enemies within {[range]} hexes get Suppressed and trigger Battle Fatigue, if they have it. The Deathleaper vanishes and cannot be targeted or damaged for 1 round. In its next turn it can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is either within Synapse range, has Tall Grass or is not adjacent to an enemy and its attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
FearOfTheUnseen.name: Fear of the Unseen

FearedInterrogator.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage against enemies that are Suppressed, Stunned, or that are adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel. Scores {[extraHits]} additional hits if the enemy is also Chaos.
FearedInterrogator.name: Feared Interrogator

FeederTendrils.description: When charging, the Deathleaper deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage, heals for {[hpToHeal]} Health and Suppresses the target for 1 round.
FeederTendrils.name: Feeder Tendrils

FieldsOfFire.description: Friendly units with the Emplacement trait deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage against units that are {[range]} or more hexes away from their own hex. Each time Thaddeus Noble is attacked in melee or would get Stunned, he loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done. The first time each round he loses Health this way, all friendly Emplacement units get Suppressed for 1 round.
FieldsOfFire.name: Fields of Fire

FightingRetreat.description: Adjacent enemies gain a Markerlight. They also have {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits, to a minimum of one, and deal -{[dmgReduction]} Damage for one round. Until the end of this turn, Darkstrider and adjacent allied units with the Ranged Specialist trait gain the effect of the trait even if they started their turn adjacent to an enemy unit. Using Fighting Retreat does not end Darkstrider's turn if he is adjacent to an enemy, and he can move again if already moved in this turn.
FightingRetreat.name: Fighting Retreat

FireAndReposition.description: May move as normal and attack. After attacking, she may make one more normal movement. In the following enemy turn, she takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from ranged attacks. Can only be used if Calandis has a target in range.
FireAndReposition.name: Fire And Reposition

FireOfAbsolution.description: When performing a ranged attack, also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Flame Damage to all units adjacent to the target. Has a {[chance]}% chance of setting each adjacent hex on Fire as well.
FireOfAbsolution.name: Fire of Absolution

FiringPosition.description: When defeating a unit with an attack triggered by Overwatch, the Havoc stays in Overwatch, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack.
FiringPosition.name: Firing Position

FirstAmongTraitors.description: Other friendly Chaos units within {[range]} hexes deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage. This value is increased by +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage for each attack Abaddon has performed in this battle, up to a maximum of +{[maxDmg]} Damage after 13 attacks.
FirstAmongTraitors.name: First Among Traitors

FlailSwing.description: Performs a melee attack dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and triggering Haze of Corruption if the target is defeated. Any unit defeated by this attack or its add-on attacks from Haze of Corruption is always overkilled.
FlailSwing.name: Flail Swing

FlamesOfMutation.description: When this unit gets defeated it sets its hex on Fire. Does not apply if Overkilled.
FlamesOfMutation.name: Flames of Mutation

FleshmetalGuns.description: At the start of his turn, Volk gains one of three effects until the start of his next turn. The effects are granted one after the other, repeating every three turns. Volk's ranged attacks score additional hits, based on the current effect: Focused Malice: {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage Ruinous Salvo: {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Flame Damage Warp Hail: {[nrOfHits_3]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Heavy Round Damage, and these hits add Despoiled Ground to the hexes of attacked units.
FleshmetalGuns.name: Fleshmetal Guns

FloatingDeath.description: Has +1 Movement when starting its turn within Synapse range. This unit explodes when it attacks or if it or an adjacent friendly Spore Mine is defeated, and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to all adjacent enemies. Does not explode when overkilled. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
FloatingDeath.name: Floating Death

Foehammer.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an enemy within range {[range]} and the target is Stunned until the beginning of Arjac's next turn. For each Character that has been defeated in this battle, this ability deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage.
Foehammer.name: Foehammer

ForwardObservers.description: Targets an enemy unit within range {[range]} that does not have a Markerlight. The target receives a Markerlight for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. The Stealth Battlesuit then receives -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage from ranged attacks for {[nrOfRounds_2]} round.
ForwardObservers.name: Forward Observers

ForwardSpotter.description: Summons a Cadian Guardsman in a hex adjacent to the targeted friendly unit. The Cadian Guardsman immediately takes a turn. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} rounds. Cadian Guardsman stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ForwardSpotter.name: Forward Spotter

FoulInfusion.description: Pestillian and all friendly Chaos units within his Contagion aura deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Toxic Damage with their normal melee attacks for this round and the next. Pestillian then immediately performs a normal melee attack against a random adjacent enemy.
FoulInfusion.name: Foul Infusion

FragBomb.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to an adjacent target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to ALL units adjacent to the target hex, except Kut Skoden himself.
FragBomb.name: Frag Bomb

FragLance.description: When charging, normal melee attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage.
FragLance.name: Frag Lance

Fragstorm.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to up to {[nrOfTargets]} random hexes adjacent to the target, excluding hexes with friendly units on them.
Fragstorm.name: Fragstorm

FragstormGrenadeLauncher.description: Deals up to {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any leftover hits are allocated to enemy units within {[range]} hexes, prioritising kills.
FragstormGrenadeLauncher.name: Fragstorm Grenade Launcher

FrenziedFiring.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a target enemy in range {[range]} and to all enemies adjacent to it. Scores an additional hit to the target for each free hex adjacent to it, up to a maximum of {[maxNrOfHits]} hits. Additional hits from Fleshmetal Guns are scored against each enemy attacked.
FrenziedFiring.name: Frenzied Firing

FuelledByFury.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage with all attacks for each time a friendly Character has used an active ability this battle. The first time each turn that Titus is defeated he cannot be Overkilled. The first time each turn he defeats an enemy with an attack triggered by Final Vengeance he is immediately revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health.
FuelledByFury.name: Fuelled by Fury

FullThrottle.description: Whenever this unit moves {[movement]} or more hexes, there’s a {[chance]}% chance its rokkit malfunctions and causes the Storm Boy to go up in flames. In this event the unit is not revivable.
FullThrottle.name: Full Throttle

FuryFromTheDelve.description: Hâvyr's normal attacks Suppress enemies that are at more than {[hpPct]}% Health. After performing a normal attack against enemies that are at or below {[hpPct]}% Health, Hâvyr performs an additional attack against them, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate.
FuryFromTheDelve.name: Fury from the Dêlve

FuryOfTheAncients.description: After moving, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to an adjacent enemy and an additional enemy adjacent to the initial one. For 2 rounds, affected units cannot be revived, healed, repaired, nor otherwise restore Health. If Mephiston does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
FuryOfTheAncients.name: Fury of the Ancients

GalvanicField.description: Whenever Actus repairs another unit, that unit immediately attacks a target in range, dealing {[dmgPct]}% of its own Damage to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage per hit. Actus can repair other friendly units even if they are at full Health.
GalvanicField.name: Galvanic Field

GauntletsOfUltramar.description: Deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to all enemies within 2 hexes. Scores an additional hit against surrounding enemies.
GauntletsOfUltramar.name: Gauntlets of Ultramar

GazeOfMagnus.description: At the end of each of his turns, Magnus turns his Gaze upon an enemy Character, choosing a Psyker if possible. At the beginning of Magnus' next turn, if that character is a Psyker or attacked Magnus while under the Gaze, it takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage and if it is a Psyker, it is Stunned for 1 round. Scores +{[extraHit]}x hit for each turn in a row that Magnus targets the same character with the Gaze. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
GazeOfMagnus.name: Gaze of Magnus

GeminaeSuperia.description: When attacked, summons a Geminae Superia in a free adjacent hex, and immediately triggers its passive ability Lifewards. Can do this twice per battle. Geminae Superia’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
GeminaeSuperia.name: Geminae Superia

GetEmRuntz.description: Summons 1 Grot in each adjacent hex that also has an enemy unit adjacent to it. Newly spawned Grots can immediately attack an enemy in melee, but cannot move this turn. Enemy units attacked by a Grot this way are Taunted for 1 round. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
GetEmRuntz.name: Get ’Em Runtz

GrapnelLauncher.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to it. If Tjark is not already adjacent to the target, it is then pulled 1 hex towards Tjark if possible, and can be pulled over any elevation but not through impassable terrain. Tjark then moves to occupy the hex the target originally occupied if it's free, or a free adjacent hex if it is not. If there are no free hexes, then Tjark does not move.
GrapnelLauncher.name: Grapnel Launcher

GravitonRifle.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical to an enemy in range {[range]} and Stuns it for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This attack has +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio against MK X Gravis, Terminator Armour or Mechanical units.
GravitonRifle.name: Graviton Rifle

GreatFrostAxe.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy and covers the hex the enemy stands on and all hexes adjacent to it in Ice. The Crit Damage bonus of the Ice is already applied for this attack.
GreatFrostAxe.name: Great Frost Axe

GrimEfficiency.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes of Ûthar gain a bonus based on Ûthar's current effect from Prioritised Efficiency: Hostile Acquisition: Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Fortify Takeover: Affected units have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with all attacks.
GrimEfficiency.name: Grim Efficiency

GrimRetribution.description: During each enemy turn, if there is no enemy adjacent to Sarquael, he shoots back at the first enemy within range that attacked him or a friendly adjacent Dark Angel. This shot counts as Overwatch and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage.
GrimRetribution.name: Grim Retribution

GrotTank.description: Calls in a Grot Tank in an adjacent free hex. The Grot Tank cannot move in its first turn, but can immediately attack an enemy in range. Grot Tank’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health +{[extraHp]} for each round that has started {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
GrotTank.name: Grot Tank

GuardianConstruct.description: Friendly Mythic characters that are affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
GuardianConstruct.name: Guardian Construct

GuardianOrganism.description: If the Tyrant Guard is within Synapse range or did not move during its previous turn, it and friendly units affected by its Big Target trait take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage during the enemy's next turn, up to a maximum of -{[dmgReduction]} Damage per hit.
GuardianOrganism.name: Guardian Organism

GunnersKillOnSight.description: Marks an area in front of the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank for 1 round. Whenever an enemy unit without Infiltrate ends a move on a marked hex or before it moves out of the marked area, the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to all units in the area. The ability ends early after {[nrOfCrits]} attacks against the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank have scored a Crit.
GunnersKillOnSight.name: Gunners, Kill on Sight!

HadesAutocannons.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to a targeted enemy summon and all other enemy summons within 2 hexes of the target. Can deal {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
HadesAutocannons.name: Hades Autocannons

HailOfLivingAmmunition.description: This unit has +{[extraHit]} hit in ranged attacks for each Termagant it is adjacent to.
HailOfLivingAmmunition.name: Hail of Living Ammunition

Hailstrike.description: Targets a friendly unit on the battlefield. For {[nrOfRounds]} round, it has +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with ranged attacks and attacks while Overwatching. When the affected unit targets an enemy with one of these attacks, the Storm Speeder attacks the same target, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Hailstrike.name: Hailstrike

HammerOfWrath.description: If Mataneo has not moved, he gains Infiltrate until the end of this turn, charges an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage to all enemies adjacent to it. If Mataneo is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, doubles the damage dealt by this ability. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HammerOfWrath.name: Hammer of Wrath

HarbingerOfDestruction.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to up to {[nrOfUnits]} enemies within {[range]} hexes.
HarbingerOfDestruction.name: Harbinger of Destruction

HarlequinsPanoply.description: The first time each turn this unit blocks a hit, all further hits of the attack are discarded and the Harlequin Player moves 1 hex closer to the origin of the attack, if possible.
HarlequinsPanoply.name: Harlequin's Panoply

HarvesterOfSouls.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a target within range {[range]} and to all enemies adjacent to the target that are also within range {[range]} of Maugan Ra. These attacks score an additional hit if Maugan Ra has not moved this turn.
HarvesterOfSouls.name: Harvester Of Souls

HatefulAssault.description: Attacks any enemy that moves from a hex adjacent to him, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage.
HatefulAssault.name: Hateful Assault

HaywireMine.description: When moving, Cyrus places a Haywire Mine on the hex he started his move on. Enemies moving onto a Haywire Mine take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast. Mechanical enemies take an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy. If Cyrus does not move, he places a Haywire Mine in a free adjacent hex at the end of his turn. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HaywireMine.name: Haywire Mine

HaywireMineSteppable.description: Enemies moving onto a Haywire Mine take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast. Mechanical enemies take an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HaywireMineSteppable.name: Haywire Mine

HazeOfCorruption.description: When {[UnitName]} attacks and defeats a unit, any leftover Damage and an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[extraDmg]} Toxic Damage is dealt to a random enemy adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target. If this unit is also defeated, this ability triggers again, dealing Damage to an additional unit adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target.
HazeOfCorruption.name: Haze of Corruption

HeadClaimer.description: For each enemy unit that Haarken has defeated, his attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for the rest of the battle. For each enemy Character that he has defeated, his attacks also score +{[extraHit]} hit for the rest of the battle.
HeadClaimer.name: Head-Claimer

HeadwoppasKillchoppa.description: Boss Gulgortz and all friendly Ork Boyz deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks for each enemy unit that Boss Gulgortz has defeated in this battle.
HeadwoppasKillchoppa.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa

HealingBalms.description: When Baldr uses his action to heal a friendly unit, the healed unit has +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. At the start of its next turn, the affected unit is also healed for {[hpToHeal]} Health. Baldr can heal friendly units even if they are at full Health.
HealingBalms.name: Healing Balms

HeavyBoltPistol.description: Deals an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Bolter Damage in melee.
HeavyBoltPistol.name: Heavy Bolt Pistol

HeavyGravCannon.description: Ranged attacks against MK X Gravis, Terminator Armour or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio.
HeavyGravCannon.name: Heavy Grav-Cannon

HeavyRailRifle.description: Targets an enemy and fires the Heavy Rail Rifle at the start of Tson'ji's next turn. If targeting a unit, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage. This damage is reduced by {[dmgPctReduction]}% for each hex the target has traversed during its last turn, to a minimum of 0 damage. Any damage dealt to Vehicles and Big Targets is increased by {[extraDmgPct]}% each. If targeting Machines of War, increases the cooldown of the target's secondary ability by {[cooldownIncrease]} round and has a {[chance]}% chance to also increase the cooldown of the primary ability by {[cooldownIncrease_2]} round. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HeavyRailRifle.name: Heavy Rail Rifle

HeavyWarpFlamer.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds +1 hit for each attack with Psychic Damage that friendly units have performed this turn. Cannot exceed {[maxNrOfHits]} hits. If this attack defeats the target, any leftover hits are scored against enemies adjacent to the target and within range {[range]}, prioritising kills.
HeavyWarpFlamer.name: Heavy Warpflamer

HellfireShells.description: Fires a burst of Hellfire shells at a target within {[range]} hexes. The shells deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage and +{[extraHit]}x hits against Big Targets. Rapid Fire does not apply to this ability.
HellfireShells.name: Hellfire Shells

HellfyreMissileRack.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a target enemy unit within range {[range]} and an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to each enemy unit on the map that was dealt Psychic Damage this turn, which can include the initial target again. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HellfyreMissileRack.name: Hellfyre Missile Rack

Helspear.description: Herald of the Apocalypse always adds Despoiled Ground to the hexes of affected enemies, and the next attack against affected enemies also ignores {[armorIgnored]} Armour. After Herald of the Apocalypse has been used and Haarken defeats {[nrOfUnits]} enemy units, he can use the ability again.
Helspear.name: Helspear

HeraldOfTheApocalypse.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy and an additional enemy directly behind the target. Affected enemies receive +{[extraDmg]} Damage from the next attack made by a unit against them. Also triggers Battle Fatigue for all enemy units within {[range]} hexes of the original target.
HeraldOfTheApocalypse.name: Herald of the Apocalypse

HeroicFusillade.description: Targets an enemy unit that has a free surrounding hex within movement range {[range]} of Judh or is already on a hex surrounding Judh. She then moves to the free hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to the target and all other enemies surrounding it. Crits deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each free hex surrounding the targeted enemy. When Judh is resurrected and Heroic Fusillade has already been used, then it can be used again in this battle.
HeroicFusillade.name: Heroic Fusillade

HolyDuel.description: Brother Jaeger Taunts an adjacent enemy unit and immediately performs a normal attack against it. Brother Jaeger deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage and takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from the target while it’s Taunted by him. Brother Jaeger is also Taunted by the target and the taunt does not expire with rounds passed.
HolyDuel.name: Holy Duel

HostOfPlagues.description: Whenever a non-Mechanical enemy unit dies there is a {[chance]}% chance a Poxwalker is spawned on the hex where that unit died.
HostOfPlagues.name: Host Of Plagues

HungeringSwarm.description: Whenever this unit performs a melee attack, it deals +{[extraHit]} hit for each other friendly Hormagaunt or Ripper Swarm adjacent to the target.
HungeringSwarm.name: Hungering Swarm

HuntTheFallen.description: At the start of the battle, a random enemy Chaos unit is identified as Fallen. If there is no Chaos unit, a random enemy unit is designated as Deathwing Quarry. All friendly Dark Angels deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage to Fallen. Each time Baraqiel is attacked by a Fallen, he loses {[hp_2]} Health in addition to the damage done, or {[hp]} Health if attacked by Deathwing Quarry. Baraqiel takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from all other attacks.
HuntTheFallen.name: Hunt the Fallen

HunterOfSouls.description: At the start of his turn, Z'Kar performs a normal attack against a target in range. This attack deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each adjacent friendly Psyker. Afterwards, Z'Kar leaves the battlefield and returns as Machine of War. If he is defeated while on the battlefield, he also returns as Machine of War.
HunterOfSouls.name: Hunter of Souls

HuntersBeyondDeath.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage against Psykers, and enemy Psykers within 2 hexes deal -{[dmgReduction]} Damage. Unless they are Immune, Enemy Psykers within 2 hexes will not hit an additional unit with their normal ranged attacks.
HuntersBeyondDeath.name: Hunters Beyond Death

HuntersInstincts.description: Gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage and takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage while on a hex with Tall Grass.
HuntersInstincts.name: Hunter's Instincts

HyperAggression.description: Beginning on its second turn, after the Screamer-Killer uses an active ability, it also performs a normal attack.
HyperAggression.name: Hyper-Aggression

HyperCorrosiveAcid.description: Enemies that are damaged by a friendly Spore Mine take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from attacks by Mythic characters for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
HyperCorrosiveAcid.name: Hyper Corrosive Acid

Hypermorph.description: Gains extra Damage equal to {[healthPct]}% of current Health.
Hypermorph.name: Hypermorph

HypersensoryAbilities.description: The first time each enemy turn that Judh is attacked, she cannot fall below {[hpPct]}% of her current Health. After the attack, she moves to a free adjacent hex and places a decoy on the hex she moved from. Then, if she is within {[range]} hexes of the unit that attacked her, she deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to that unit.
HypersensoryAbilities.name: Hypersensory Abilities

IconOfObstinacy.description: Lysander and all friendly adjacent Terminator Armour units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage. When they end their turn without attacking, they also have +{[extraArmor]} Armour until the beginning of their next turn. The additional Damage and Armour are further increased by {[chance]}% of the affected unit's current Block Damage value.
IconOfObstinacy.name: Icon of Obstinacy

IllusionsOfTzeentch.description: At the start of the battle, creates a copy of the enemy team to fight for him. Copies have the same stats and ability levels as the original units. As long as one of these copies is on the battlefield, reduce all incoming damage to Thaumachus by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Each time a copied character is defeated for the first time, Thaumachus loses {[hp]} Health.
IllusionsOfTzeentch.name: Illusions of Tzeentch

ImpossibleForm.description: Each turn, the 9th attack and every 9th additional attack against Magnus deal -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage.
ImpossibleForm.name: Impossible Form

IncendiaryShells.description: Fires the Astartes shotgun at an enemy within {[range]} hexes, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage.
IncendiaryShells.name: Incendiary Shells

Incursion.description: Summons a Bloodletter adjacent to an enemy target within range {[range]}. The Bloodletter immediately attacks the target. Keeps summoning Bloodletters up to a max of {[maxSummons]}, as long as the target has not been defeated, is in range and has a free hex adjacent to it. Bloodletter’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
Incursion.name: Daemonic Incursion

InescapableAccuracy.description: If Maugan Ra has not moved, then his ranged attacks ignore hit reductions, have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance, and deal an additional {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. Inescapable Accuracy applies to targets of Harvester of Souls as well as attacks triggered by Overwatch.
InescapableAccuracy.name: Inescapable Accuracy

InescapableDeath.description: Imospekh deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage while Overwatching. When Imospekh defeats a unit while Overwatching, they stay in Overwatch, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack.
InescapableDeath.name: Inescapable Death

InfernalCannon.description: Targets a hex on the battlefield. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies that are on Fire hexes or have taken Psychic Damage this turn. Then adds Fire to the targeted hex. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
InfernalCannon.name: Infernal Cannon

InfernalPacts.description: Friendly Chaos units adjacent to Abraxas deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage with their normal ranged attacks. Affected Daemons also gain the bonus hit on their normal melee attack.
InfernalPacts.name: Infernal Pacts

InspiredToGreatness.description: Enables a friendly unit in an adjacent hex to use their active ability again in this battle and heals or repairs it for {[hpToHeal]} Health. For this second use, the ability is at the lowest of its own level and that of Inspired to Greatness. If that unit has not used their active ability yet, then {[hpToHeal_2]} Health is restored instead.
InspiredToGreatness.name: Inspired to Greatness

InstrumentsOfVengeance.description: Lion El'Jonson marks hexes in two straight lines, originating from the edges of the battlefield. At the end of this turn, if there is no enemy unit adjacent to Lion El'Jonson, he starts Overwatching. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemies on marked hexes take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} HeavyRound. Lion El'Jonson then summons {[nrOfSummons]} Deathwing Knights in free hexes on the battlefield. They can immediately attack enemies in range, but cannot move this turn. Deathwing Knight stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
InstrumentsOfVengeance.name: Instruments of Vengeance

IntegratedCircuits.description: Any time a friendly unit is Overkilled, the Menhir also takes that same amount of Damage as Direct Damage.
IntegratedCircuits.name: Integrated Circuits

IntoxicatingElixir.description: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each unit within range {[range]} that is Suppressed, Stunned, Taunted, or Thrilled, up to a maximum of {[nrOfUnits]} times. This bonus is doubled if the relic bearer is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health.
IntoxicatingElixir.name: Intoxicating Elixir

InvocationOfMachineVengeance.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} Tech-Priest Enginseers at the bottom of the map. Then adds {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance to all friendly Mechanical units on the battlefield. Tech-Priest Enginseer stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
InvocationOfMachineVengeance.name: Invocation of Machine Vengeance

IronkinSteeljack.description: Summons an Ironkin Steeljack in a free adjacent hex. The Ironkin Steeljack can immediately attack, but cannot move this turn. Ironkin Steeljack stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
IronkinSteeljack.name: Ironkin Steeljack

ItItches.description: Suppresses and pushes an adjacent enemy unit and all enemy units adjacent to both the target and the Parasite of Mortrex one hex backwards. Enemy steppables on affected hexes are destroyed. Then summons a Ripper Swarm in each hex vacated by this ability. The Ripper Swarms can immediately attack. The Parasite of Mortrex may move again after activating this ability. Ripper Swarm stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ItItches.name: It Itches!

ItsGonnaBlow.description: If this unit is Overkilled the ammo box explodes, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all adjacent hexes. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ItsGonnaBlow.name: It’s Gonna Blow

JakhalStimms.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent enemy and all other enemies adjacent to both Macer and the target. Then Macer loses {[hpPct]}% of his current Health. Using Jakhal Stimms does not end Macer's turn.
JakhalStimms.name: Jakhal Stimms

KardiocoreGalvanus.description: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each friendly adjacent Mechanical unit.
KardiocoreGalvanus.name: Kardiocore Galvanus

KillMaimBurn.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to an adjacent enemy. Then performs a second attack targeting an adjacent enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Eviscerating Damage. Then performs a third attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits_3]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Plasma Damage. All attacks prioritise the same target until it is killed and then prioritise kills.
KillMaimBurn.name: Kill! Maim! Burn!

KissOfDeath.description: The Harlequin Player disappears and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Direct Damage to an adjacent enemy, and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to a previous target, then it reappears in a hex adjacent to the last target hit.
KissOfDeath.name: Kiss of Death

KustomForceFieldReworked.description: All friendly adjacent units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Gibbascrapz and other friendly adjacent Orks have +{[extraArmor_2]} Armour instead and ignore Battle Fatigue, if they have it.
KustomForceFieldReworked.name: Kustom Force Field

Lakrimae.description: Typhus' normal melee attacks add Contamination to the target's hex. During his turn, when a non-mechanical enemy unit within Typhus' Contagion aura is killed, he summons a Poxwalker in the hex of the defeated unit, as long as there are less than {[nrOfUnits]} friendly Poxwalkers on the battlefield. The Poxwalkers have {[summonHp]} Health and {[summonDmg]} Damage.
Lakrimae.name: Lakrimae

LashOfTorment.description: Deals{[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]}. If the target is not already adjacent to Lucius, it is then pulled 1 hex towards him if possible, and can be pulled over any elevation but not through impassable terrain. If the target is adjacent to Lucius after the attack, it is also Taunted by him for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds.
LashOfTorment.name: Lash of Torment

LeadingTheCharge.description: If Dreir has not moved, he gains Infiltrate until the end of this turn and charges an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to it. Then, summons up to {[nrOfSummons]} Death Riders in free adjacent hexes that can immediately attack enemies in range. All attacks triggered by this ability have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle. Death Rider stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
LeadingTheCharge.name: Leading the Charge

LegacyOfCombat.description: After performing his first attack each turn, Kariyan performs an additional attack. If he is adjacent to an enemy Big Target, this attack deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Piercing Damage to it. If there is no adjacent enemy Big Target, Kariyan deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to each adjacent enemy instead.
LegacyOfCombat.name: Legacy Of Combat

LegendaryCommander.description: Enemies receive +{[extraDmg]} Damage if they are adjacent to any friendly unit that has used an active ability this turn. If the affected enemies are also adjacent to Trajann, friendly Characters score {[nrOfHits]} additional hits against them with their first attack that is not a normal attack.
LegendaryCommander.name: Legendary Commander

LethalMiasma.description: At the start of the Tervigon’s turn, any adjacent enemy units suffer {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage.
LethalMiasma.name: Lethal Miasma

Lifewards.description: If Celestine is in an adjacent hex and takes Damage, that post-Armour Damage is taken as Direct Damage by the Geminae Superia instead.
Lifewards.name: Lifewards

LightImUp.description: After performing a normal attack, Boss Gulgortz performs a second attack against the same enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to any random enemy target within {[range]} hexes.
LightImUp.name: Light ’im up!

LightOfSanguinius.description: If Dante has not moved, he gains Infiltrate until the end of this turn, then charges an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage to it. The target and enemy units surrounding it deal -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This effect is doubled if they attack friendly units that are at or below {[healthPct]}% Health.
LightOfSanguinius.name: Light of Sanguinius

LionHelm.description: Friendly units within {[range]} hexes block an additional {[blockDmg]} Damage when they Block and deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with attacks triggered by Overwatch. Other friendly Dark Angels within {[range]} hexes also have their Block chance increased by +{[blockChance]}%
LionHelm.name: Lion Helm
