ListenUpMaggots.description: When Kell is in play, Lord Castellan Creed’s active ability summons 1 extra Cadian Guardsman and has {[range]} hexes range instead of 2.
ListenUpMaggots.name: Listen Up, Maggots!

LivingBatteringRam.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent target with a {[stunChance]}% chance to stun it for 1 round. The target is also thrown 2 hexes away from the Screamer-Killer. If the hex the target lands in was occupied, the occupying unit will be pushed 1 hex in a random direction. The target is then dealt an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage, regardless if it was thrown or not.
LivingBatteringRam.name: Living Battering Ram

LivingLightning.description: After moving, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to a random enemy within range 2. If Thutmose does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
LivingLightning.name: Living Lightning

Loki_SwoopingHawk.description: Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[0]]} Piercing Damage to first target, {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[1]]} Piercing Damage to the second, and {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[2]]} Piercing Damage to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Loki_SwoopingHawk.name: Swooping Hawk

LordOfTempests.description: Njal's normal attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each hex surrounding him that is covered in Ice. The hex of each enemy that is hit by Njal's normal attacks is covered in Ice at the end of the attack.
LordOfTempests.name: Lord Of Tempests

LordOfTheHost.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes with Rapid Assault or Flying deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks. Affected units that are at or below {[healthPct]}% Health also score an additional hit with melee attacks.
LordOfTheHost.name: Lord of the Host

MV71SniperDroneSquad.description: Instead of a ranged attack, Sho'syl summons a MV71 Sniper Drone and commands it to attack the target. This attack uses Sho'syl's Damage stat, while other effects, like buffs, are taken from the Drone. If Sho'syl already controls {[maxSummons]} MV71 Sniper Drones, the one with the lowest Health is removed before the new Drone is summoned. The target also gains a Markerlight until the end of Sho'syl's next turn. MV71 Sniper Drones' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
MV71SniperDroneSquad.name: MV71 Sniper Drone Squad

MacroPlasmaIncinerator.description: Marks a target hex and the two hexes behind it for 1 round. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to all enemies in the marked area the first time an enemy unit ends their movement in it. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MacroPlasmaIncinerator.name: Macro Plasma Incinerator

MalleusRocketLauncher.description: Marks a hex on the battlefield. At the beginning of the Field Ordnance Battery's next turn, it unleashes a barrage of missiles. {[nrOfProjectiles]} missiles impact on the marked hex and {[nrOfProjectiles_2]} missiles impact in hexes adjacent to the target with a maximum of {[nrOfProjectiles_3]} impacts per unit. Each impact deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage and all units hit get Suppressed. Enemies hit within {[range]} hexes of a friendly Astra Militarum unit take +{[extraDmg]} damage from each hit. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MalleusRocketLauncher.name: Malleus Rocket Barrage

MartialExemplar.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to all adjacent enemies. Then moves up to {[nrOfTiles]} hex towards the closest enemy unit and performs a normal attack. These attacks and all further attacks this turn have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance against Summons.
MartialExemplar.name: Martial Exemplar

MartialInspiration.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an adjacent enemy. This attack and attacks from Legacy of Combat this turn deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage for each turn in which Kariyan performed an attack this battle. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds.
MartialInspiration.name: Martial Inspiration

MartialSuperiority.description: If Brother Jaeger gets targeted with a melee attack from an adjacent enemy during the enemy’s turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the attacker before the enemy attack executes.
MartialSuperiority.name: Martial Superiority

MassDriverAccelerator.description: Can only be used if Kîmm has not moved. She and all friendly adjacent units have +{[extraMovement]} Movement until the end of this turn. Kîmm then charges a targeted enemy unit within movement range, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to the target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage to all enemies adjacent to the target.
MassDriverAccelerator.name: Mass Driver Accelerator

MassiveScythingTalons.description: When the Tervigon attacks an enemy in melee, any enemy units adjacent to that target and to the Tervigon take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage.
MassiveScythingTalons.name: Massive Scything Talons

MasterAnnihilator.description: When Vitruvius performs a normal attack against an enemy, that enemy is affected by Master Annihilator until Vitruvius is defeated or performs a normal attack against a different unit. Attacks by any friendly unit against the affected enemy score an additional hit, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. This additional hit can deal a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage.
MasterAnnihilator.name: Master Annihilator

MasterOfTheTutelaries.description: Summon a Pink Horror on a free hex adjacent to Abraxas. Until the end of this turn, whenever an enemy unit is dealt Psychic Damage, summon a Screamer of Tzeentch on a free hex adjacent to Abraxas, preferring hexes adjacent to enemy units. Newly summoned units can immediately attack an enemy in range but cannot move. Pink Horror stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage Screamer of Tzeentch stats: {[summonHp_2]} Health {[summonDmg_2]} Damage
MasterOfTheTutelaries.name: Malefic Maelstrom

MastersOfManoeuvre.description: Friendly Mythic characters take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from ranged attacks until the start of their next turn if they have traversed {[tilesTraversed]} or more hexes during their turn or end their turn next to a friendly Mythic Dark Angel.
MastersOfManoeuvre.name: Masters of Manoeuvre

Maugetar.description: During his turn, if Maugan Ra has not moved, he can move after attacking and his attacks that contain a Crit deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage. When Overwatching, Crits deal this additional hit if he has not moved in his last turn.
Maugetar.name: Maugetar

MawClawsOfThyrax.description: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each adjacent Summon.
MawClawsOfThyrax.name: Maw-Claws of Thyrax

MedicusMinistorum.description: Any friendly adjacent non-mechanical unit that takes Damage regenerates {[hpToHeal]} Health afterwards, unless it is defeated.
MedicusMinistorum.name: Medicus Ministorum

MightFromBelow.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to an adjacent enemy, then summons a Purestrain Genestealer on each decoy adjacent to the Patermine. The Purestrain Genestealers can immediately attack in melee, but cannot move this turn. Purestrain Genestealer stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MightFromBelow.name: Might From Below

MindControl.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes that is adjacent to one or more friendly units. For this round and the next, that enemy unit deals -{[dmgReduction]} Damage, takes +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage, and becomes Taunted by the adjacent unit with the highest current Health.
MindControl.name: Mind Control

MischiefMakers.description: Targets of the Nurglings' normal attacks cannot be revived, healed, repaired, or otherwise restore Health for {[nrOfRounds]} round. These attacks additionally have a {[chance]}% chance to Suppress the target for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
MischiefMakers.name: Mischief Makers

ModifiedExoarmour.description: Attacks against Kîmm have -{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage or Direct Damage, to a minimum of 1% Pierce Ratio. Kîmm's melee attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each hex she traversed this turn.
ModifiedExoarmour.name: Modified Exoarmour

MoltenForm.description: Flame, Plasma, and Melta Damage against the Avatar of Khaine is reduced by {[dmgPctReduction]}%.
MoltenForm.name: Molten Form

MomentShackle.description: Trajann heals himself for {[hpToHeal]} Health. For {[nrOfRounds]} round, Trajann has +{[blockChance]}% Block chance and blocks an additional +{[blockDmg]} Damage. During that round, he also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to each enemy unit that moves from a hex adjacent to him.
MomentShackle.name: Moment Shackle

MonsterSlayerOfCaliban.description: Forcas deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage to Big Targets and Vehicles. He also has an added {[blockChance]}% chance to Block {[blockDmg]} Damage.
MonsterSlayerOfCaliban.name: Monster Slayer of Caliban

MoreGitzOverEre.description: Enemies that are adjacent to a friendly Squig or adjacent to two or more friendly Mythic characters take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from normal melee attacks by Mythic characters.
MoreGitzOverEre.name: More Gitz Over 'Ere!

MortarionsPlagueWind.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage. Summons take double damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MortarionsPlagueWind.name: Mortarion's Plague Wind

MortisRound.description: Deals 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a single target within range 3, which is then pushed back 1 hex. The Heavy Weapon trait applies double to this ability.
MortisRound.name: Mortis Round

MultiThreatEliminator.description: Deals 6x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage to an enemy within range {[range]}. Any leftover hits are allocated to another enemy adjacent to the target and in range {[range]}. Each enemy killed adds +{[extraHit]} hit and the ability keeps targeting new enemies until there are no more enemies or hits left.
MultiThreatEliminator.name: Multi-Threat Eliminator

MultiTracker.description: All enemy units that did not move during their turn receive a Markerlight.
MultiTracker.name: Multi-Target

MurderousSwing.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to all adjacent enemies. If this attack only hits one enemy, it deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage.
MurderousSwing.name: Murderous Swing

MyWillBeDone.description: Immediately trigger one attack by each friendly Necron unit on the battlefield from their current hex and as long as they have a target in range.
MyWillBeDone.name: Voice of the Triarch

MyWillBeDoneOverlord.description: At the end of Anuphet's turn, a friendly adjacent Mechanical unit performs a normal attack against a target in range, using {[dmgPct]}% of its own Damage stat to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage. If no attack was performed this way, Anuphet gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of his next turn.
MyWillBeDoneOverlord.name: My Will Be Done

NanoscarabRepairProtocols.description: Targets a friendly mechanical unit that is not affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols. It is now affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols for the rest of the battle. The target immediately gains {[hp]} Health and its maximum Health increases by the same amount. When the affected unit regains Health, the amount it regains is increased by {[hpToRepair]} Health.
NanoscarabRepairProtocols.name: Nanoscarab Repair Protocols

Narthecium.description: When an adjacent friendly non-Mechanical unit is defeated, it is immediately revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, unless Overkilled. Can only be triggered once per turn.
Narthecium.name: Narthecium

NeedsMoreDakka.description: Ghazghkull faces in one of 6 directions and loads up Mork's Roar as he prepares to open fire on an area in range {[range]} in front of him. At the beginning of his next turn, all units in the marked area receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage while he unleashes an intense hail of bullets. Targets adjacent to Ghazghkull receive {[nrOfHits_2]}x additional hits. Friendly Orks receive {[hitsReductionPct]}% fewer hits.
NeedsMoreDakka.name: Needs More Dakka!

NetherRealmCasket.description: The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each adjacent friendly Mechanical unit and regenerates an additional {[hpToHeal]} Health from Living Metal.
NetherRealmCasket.name: Nether-Realm Casket

Neuroparasite.description: Each enemy that is dealt Psychic Damage by the Neurothrope is infected by a Neuroparasite until either the unit is healed or the Neurothrope is defeated. Whenever a unit infected with a Neuroparasite takes Psychic Damage or becomes affected by an attack or ability that would Suppress it, the level of the Neuroparasite increases by 1, up to a maximum of {[buffMaxLevel]}. Psychic Damage dealt by the Neurothrope is increased by +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each level of a Neuroparasite on the target.
Neuroparasite.name: Neuroparasite

Nightshroud.description: All friendly units starting their turn adjacent to Sibyll Devine gain Infiltrate for that turn and take -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from each hit in their and the next enemy turn.
Nightshroud.name: Nightshroud

NoHidingFromTheWatchers.description: Any Damage this unit takes is reduced to 0. After being attacked, this unit moves {[nrOfTiles]} hex, trying to move away from all other units. If there is no other friendly Dark Angel on the battlefield except other Watchers in the Dark, then this unit leaves the battlefield.
NoHidingFromTheWatchers.name: No Hiding from the Watchers

NoctilithBeacons.description: Szarekh and all Necrons adjacent to him take -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage from all enemies with the Psyker trait.
NoctilithBeacons.name: Noctilith Beacons

NornCrown.description: The maximum level of Neuroparasite is increased by {[effectLevel]}. Other friendly Psykers within Synapse range and friendly Summons within Synapse range deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage to enemies that are affected by Neuroparasite.
NornCrown.name: Norn Crown

NovaBoost.description: Marks all hexes adjacent to the Riptide. Trenches cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage to each enemy on marked hexes and then flies to a new location on the battlefield.
NovaBoost.name: Nova Boost

NovaCharge.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a 3-tile wide line, originating from the Riptide and additionally marks {[nrOfTargets]} hexes that are not on this line. Trenches cannot be marked. At the beginning of the Riptide's next turn, it deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage to all enemies on the hexes marked by the line, and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage to all enemies on the other marked hexes.
NovaCharge.name: Nova Charge

NovaShield.description: The Riptide gains a Shield with {[shieldHp]} Health and receives +{[blockChance]}% Block chance for {[nrOfRounds]} round. It then marks a hex on the battlefield and all hexes adjacent to it. Trenches cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage to all enemies on marked hexes.
NovaShield.name: Nova Shield

ObeisanceGenerators.description: Enemy units charging Szarekh score -{[hitsReduction]} hits, to a minimum of 1 hit. Summons charging Szarekh score -{[hitsReduction_2]} hits, to a minimum of 1 hit.
ObeisanceGenerators.name: Obeisance Generators

ObsessiveAnnunciation.description: All enemy units adjacent to Adamatar take +{[extraDmg]} Damage from ranged attacks. If an enemy was Overkilled this turn, enemies adjacent to Adamatar take +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage from all attacks by friendly Chaos units.
ObsessiveAnnunciation.name: Obsessive Annunciation

OiWatchIt.description: When this unit is attacked, a steppable crate of Coins is spawned in a free adjacent hex for each hit taken.
OiWatchIt.name: Oi Watch It

OmnissiahsBlessing.description: Whenever the Tech-Priest Enginseer repairs another unit, it transfers all levels of Machine Vengeance it has to the repaired unit.
OmnissiahsBlessing.name: Omnissiah's Blessing

OnMyPosition.description: Enemies that are adjacent to a friendly Cadian Guardsman or a friendly Mythic character take +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage from ranged attacks by mythic characters.
OnMyPosition.name: On my Position!

OptimizedGait.description: Whenever an enemy adjacent to Exitor-Rho is attacked by another friendly Mechanical unit, Exitor-Rho deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to that enemy. If an enemy adjacent to Exitor-Rho is defeated by a friendly Mechanical unit or an attack triggered from this ability, Exitor-Rho moves onto its hex.
OptimizedGait.name: Optimised Gait

OrbsOfDecay.description: The relic bearer's normal attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to enemy units that have their Armour reduced by {[armorReductionPct]}% or more and are also on or adjacent to the target's hex. Additionally, the target's hex is Contaminated.
OrbsOfDecay.name: Orbs of Decay

OverwhelmingWrath.description: Until the beginning of his next turn Azkor Taunts all adjacent enemies and takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from ranged attacks. Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to all adjacent enemies at the beginning of Azkor's next turn.
OverwhelmingWrath.name: Overwhelming Wrath

ParagonSpear.description: All of Tyrith's hits that are Crits deal the maximum possible Damage. At the beginning of Tyrith's turn, she attacks a random enemy within range {[range]} and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to it. If there is an enemy adjacent to her, this range is reduced to 1.
ParagonSpear.name: Paragon Spear

PathOfCommand.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage. Their Crit chance – if they have one – is increased by +{[extraCritChance]}%. Affected Aeldari units gain an additional +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage.
PathOfCommand.name: Path Of Command

PhaeronOfTheBlades.description: All adjacent Necrons deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks.
PhaeronOfTheBlades.name: Phaeron of the Blades

PhaeronOfTheStars.description: All adjacent Necrons deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks.
PhaeronOfTheStars.name: Phaeron of the Stars

Phantasm.description: As long as there is a Phantasm, all incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. If Eldryon becomes the target of an attack when there is no Phantasm, he moves to a random free hex and leaves a Phantasm behind, preferring hexes within range 3 if possible. This movement can traverse impassable hexes and enemies and move between any elevation. When a unit moves onto the Phantasm it is destroyed and Eldryon loses {[hp]} Health.
Phantasm.name: Phantasm

PhasalSubjugator.description: After moving, if there is no friendly Necron Warrior on the battlefield, Anuphet summons a Necron Warrior in a free adjacent hex. If Anuphet does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn. After My Will Be Done triggers, it triggers a second time, but only a friendly adjacent Necron Warrior that was not affected by it this turn can perform an attack. The Necron Warriors have {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.
PhasalSubjugator.name: Phasal Subjugator

PhoenixGem.description: The first time each battle that Aethana is defeated, she is instead revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health remaining, even if Overkilled.
PhoenixGem.name: Phoenix Gem

PileIn.description: If this unit has full Health at the end of its turn, it has a {[chance]}% chance to summon another Grot in an adjacent free hex, -{[chance_2]}% for each friendly Grot currently on the board. The spawned Grot acts as normal on its next turn. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
PileIn.name: Pile In

PinpointCounterOffensive.description: Re'vas can use her active ability {[maxNrOfActivations]} times per Battle. Additionally, she takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from all attacks, but loses {[hp]} Health each time she is attacked by a unit with either the Infiltrate or Terminator Armour traits, or by a unit that has Infiltrate from an ability.
PinpointCounterOffensive.name: Pinpoint Counter Offensive

PlagueWind.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PlagueWind.name: Plague Wind

PlagueburstMortar.description: Targets a hex on the battlefield. All enemies on that hex or adjacent hexes that also either have their Armour reduced or are within a friendly Contagion aura take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage and become Suppressed for 1 round. Then adds Contamination to the target hex and random hexes adjacent to it, up to a total of {[nrOfTiles]} hexes. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PlagueburstMortar.name: Plagueburst Mortar

PlasmaCannon.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to an enemy within range {[range]} and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} round. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
PlasmaCannon.name: Plasma Cannon

PlasmaGrenade.description: Throws a grenade at a target within {[range]} hexes, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to it and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to enemy units in adjacent hexes. This ability benefits from Indirect Fire. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PlasmaGrenade.name: Plasma Grenade

Possession.description: Each time Archimatos kills an enemy unit with a melee attack, he summons a Bloodletter in its hex. Each time he kills an enemy unit with a ranged attack, he summons a Blue Horror in its hex. Bloodletter’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage Blue Horror's stats: {[summonHp_2]} Health {[summonDmg_2]} Damage
Possession.name: Possession

PoundThemToDust.description: Performs a normal attack and then marks an area of up to 7 hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to all units in the marked area.
PoundThemToDust.name: Pound them to Dust!

PowerTrip.description: Normal attacks ignore {[armorIgnored]} Armour. If Snappawrecka is at full Health, his normal attacks additionally score +{[extraHit]} hit and reduce the target's Armour by {[armorReduction]} Armour, but also cause Snappawrecka to lose {[hpPct]}% of his maximum Health.
PowerTrip.name: Power Trip

PowerUp_Armor.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their Armour by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max Health.
PowerUp_Armor.name: Armour power-up

PowerUp_Bomb.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, triggers an explosion that deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all enemies within {[range]} hexes of the pick-up hex. The damage is increased at higher rarity tiers.
PowerUp_Bomb.name: Bomb power-up

PowerUp_Damage.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their Damage by {[dmgPct]}%.
PowerUp_Damage.name: Damage power-up

PowerUp_Healing.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up heals that unit for {[HealPercentage]}% of their max Health.
PowerUp_Healing.name: Healing power-up

PowerUp_Health.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their Health by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max Health.
PowerUp_Health.name: Health power-up

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys Kariyan onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly characters. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is always overkilled.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.name: From Golden Light

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_Uthar.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys Uthar onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly characters. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is always overkilled.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_Uthar.name: BLADE OF THE ANCESTORS

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_VexilusPraetor.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys Aesoth onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly characters. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is always overkilled.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_VexilusPraetor.name: From Golden Light

PowerUp_Hits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of hits on their attacks by +{[extraHit]}.
PowerUp_Hits.name: Hits power-up

PowerUp_MeleeHits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of hits on their melee attack by +{[extraHit]}.
PowerUp_MeleeHits.name: Melee hits power-up

PowerUp_ReactivateAbility.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up allows them to use their active ability again during the ongoing battle.
PowerUp_ReactivateAbility.name: Reactivate ability power-up

PowerUp_Reinforcement.description: Adds 1 Reinforcement point when picked up by a friendly unit.
PowerUp_Reinforcement.name: Reinforcement Point power-up

PowerUp_ReinforcementShield.description: When picked up by a unit, each deployed character in this event will deploy with a Shield equal to {[shieldPct]}% of their max Health. The shield strength accumulates with each additional Shield power-up you pick up.
PowerUp_ReinforcementShield.name: Shield power-up

PowerUp_Resurrect.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, resurrects a chosen character that has been defeated. The resurrected character spawns in a random free hex and can immediately take a turn. If there is no eligible character, it adds 1 Reinforcement point instead.
PowerUp_Resurrect.name: Resurrection power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_bloodSmnIntercessor.description: Summons Jump Pack Intercessor. Jump Pack Intercessor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_bloodSmnIntercessor.name: Jump Pack Intercessor Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnHellblaster.description: Summons Hellblaster. Hellblaster's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnHellblaster.name: Hellblaster Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnTerminator.description: Summons Deathwing Knight. Deathwing Knight's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnTerminator.name: Deathwing Knight Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_templSmnAggressor.description: Summons Aggressor. Aggressor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_templSmnAggressor.name: Aggressor Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnHeavyInterce.description: Summons Heavy Intercessor. Heavy Intercessor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnHeavyInterce.name: Heavy Intercessor Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnInceptor.description: Summons Inceptor. Inceptor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnInceptor.name: Inceptor Power-up

Poxwalkers.description: Summons Poxwalkers in {[chance]}-{[chance_2]}% of free hexes (rounded up) within Corrodius' Contagion aura. Newly summoned Poxwalkers immediately attack in melee, but cannot move this turn. Poxwalker’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
Poxwalkers.name: Poxwalkers

PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.description: If Belisarius Cawl has at least {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance at the start of his turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to all enemies on the battlefield.
PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.name: Pre-Calibrated Purge Solution

PrecisionShot.description: The Deathmark neither moves nor attacks for a turn, but instead takes aim. On its next turn, it is not allowed to move, but is able to fire its Synaptic Disintegrator with incredible accuracy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Energy Damage.
PrecisionShot.name: Precision Shot

PredictiveGuidance.description: Enemies within 2 hexes of Âmmuk are affected by Predictive Guidance. If an affected enemy did not move in its last turn, other friendly Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks against it. If an affected enemy moved in its last turn, other friendly Leagues of Votann or Mechanical units deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage with ranged attacks against it. Other friendly Leagues of Votann units also score an additional hit with all attacks against affected enemies.
PredictiveGuidance.name: Predictive Guidance

PrehensilePincerTail.description: When the Hive Tyrant attacks an enemy in melee, that target or an enemy unit adjacent to both the target and the Hive Tyrant takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage.
PrehensilePincerTail.name: Prehensile Pincer Tail

PrimarchOfTheFirstLegion.description: Half of the hits (rounded down) scored against Lion El'Jonson are scored against other friendly adjacent Dark Angels instead. Friendly Dark Angels that take Damage this way deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
PrimarchOfTheFirstLegion.name: Primarch of the First Legion

PriorityReclamation.description: While there is an Archeotec Crate on the battlefield, Actus receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage, but loses {[hp]} Health each time an enemy destroys an Archeotec Crate. At the end of his turn, if Actus is adjacent to an Archeotec Crate, he removes one Archeotec Crate and all friendly Mechanical units gain {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance.
PriorityReclamation.name: Priority Reclamation

ProperKilly.description: Always eager to engage the toughest foe, Ghazghkull's melee attack prioritises the unit with the highest current health total. He slashes with Gork's Klaw, attacking all enemies in the 3 hexes in front of him. Each target takes {[nrOfHits]} hit that deals {[dmgPct]}% of their Max Health as Power Damage. When damage is dealt this way, each target hit is also Stunned for 1 round. Afterwards each target is hit with Ghazghkull's normal melee attack.
ProperKilly.name: Proper Killy

ProphetOfGorkAndMork.description: After being attacked {[nrOfAttacks]} times in a turn, Ghazghkull takes -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage until the end of that turn.
ProphetOfGorkAndMork.name: Prophet of Gork and Mork

PropheticSentinel.description: Adjacent friendly Chaos units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Adjacent friendly Psykers have +{[blockChance]}% Block chance and block +{[blockDmg]} Damage. At the end of its turn, if the Sekhetar Robot is adjacent to a friendly Psyker, it starts Overwatching, even if it attacked during its turn.
PropheticSentinel.name: Prophetic Sentinel

PsychicDominion.description: Magnus takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Psychic Damage and Psykers receive +{[dmgPct]}% Damage from his attacks.
PsychicDominion.name: Psychic Dominion

PsychicFortress.description: All friendly surrounding units have an added Block with {[blockChance]}% chance to block {[blockDmg]} Damage. Also reduces incoming Psychic Damage by {[dmgReduction]}.
PsychicFortress.name: Psychic Fortress

PsychicMaelstrom.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. {[chance]}% chance to score another hit. If it does, {[chance_2]}% chance to score another hit. If it does, {[chance_3]}% chance to score another hit. If it does, {[chance_4]}% chance to score another hit. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PsychicMaelstrom.name: Psychic Maelstrom

PsychicStalk.description: Attacks that deal Flame Damage and Psychic Damage to enemies that are on hexes with Fire deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage. Affected attacks from friendly Chaos units deal an additional +{[extraDmg]} Damage. The hex of each enemy that is hit by Ahriman's normal ranged attack catches Fire.
PsychicStalk.name: Psychic Stalk

PurgeResponse.description: At the end of their turn, if the Ironkin Steeljack is adjacent to a friendly Leagues of Votann character, they start Overwatching, even if they attacked in their turn. While Overwatching, the Ironkin Steeljack's attacks ignore hit reductions.
PurgeResponse.name: Purge Response

Pyreblaster.description: When performing a ranged attack, sets the hex behind the enemy on Fire and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to any enemy on that hex.
Pyreblaster.name: Pyreblaster

RadBombardment.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to all units in a straight line in one of 6 directions and adds Contamination to all hexes in the line. All units hit are Suppressed for 1 round. The length of the line starts at 2 hexes and increases by 1 hex for each round that has passed and by 1 hex each time a friendly Mechanic restores Health of a unit. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
RadBombardment.name: Rad-Bombardment

RadSaturation.description: After the Skitarii Vanguard moves, it adds Contamination to its hex. If it does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of its turn.
RadSaturation.name: Rad-Saturation

RadZoneCorps.description: At the beginning of Tan Gi'Da's turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to each enemy that has their Armour reduced. At the end of his turn, he summons {[nrOfSummons]} Skitarii Vanguard at the top of the map and Contaminates one row of hexes on the battlefield. Skitarii Vanguard stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
RadZoneCorps.name: Rad-Zone Corps

Ramshackle.description: Takes -{[dmgReduction]} damage from attacks with damage types that have {[pierceRatio]}% pierce ratio or lower.
Ramshackle.name: Ramshackle

RapidFire.description: The Heavy Intercessor attacks twice if he did not move this turn, with each of the two attacks dealing Damage as normal.
RapidFire.name: Rapid Fire

RealityUnbound.description: For each different enemy unit that was dealt Psychic Damage this turn Yazaghor deals +{[extraMaxDmg]} Maximum Damage with his normal ranged attacks. If three or more different enemy units have been dealt Psychic Damage this turn he gains +{[extraMovement]} Movement and his normal ranged attack gets +{[extraRange]} Range until the end of this turn.
RealityUnbound.name: Reality Unbound

ReanimationBeam.description: All friendly units that are affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols are repaired for {[hpToRepair]} Health. Affected Summons immediately take an action, using {[dmgPct]}% of their own Damage stat to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage when attacking. Until the start of the Reanimator's next turn, the first time a friendly unit affected by Nanoscarab Repair Protocols would be defeated, it is instead revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, unless Overkilled. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition.
ReanimationBeam.name: Reanimation Beam

ReanimationProtocols.description: If there is at least one other friendly unit of the same type on the battlefield when this unit is defeated, it has a {[chance]}% chance to be immediately revived with {[hpPct]}% of its initial Health in the same hex or a random adjacent one. Does not apply if Overkilled.
ReanimationProtocols.name: Reanimation Protocols

ReapingScythe.description: Attacks a unit in melee by swinging Silence in a wide arc, hitting the target and all enemy units adjacent to the target for {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Chain Damage. Mortarion prefers to target Psykers with this ability.
ReapingScythe.name: Reaping Scythe

RedRampage.description: After moving, Cezare deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to all adjacent enemies. If he does not move, this attack triggers at the end of his turn. If Cezare defeats at least one enemy unit during his turn, he gains +{[extraMovement]} Movement until the end of his next turn.
RedRampage.name: Red Rampage

RedThirst.description: If this unit is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, it gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage and scores +{[extraHit]} hit when charging.
RedThirst.name: Red Thirst

RedemptionOfTheRisen.description: Each time a friendly Dark Angel is defeated by a Chaos enemy, Forcas loses {[hp]} Health. If a friendly Dark Angel is defeated during the enemy turn, Forcas and all friendly Dark Angels start Overwatching. As long as there is another friendly Dark Angel on the battlefield, Forcas and friendly adjacent Dark Angels take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage.
RedemptionOfTheRisen.name: Redemption of the Risen

RefusalToBeOutdone.description: Friendly characters attacking enemies adjacent to Laviscus increase his Outrage equal to the highest damage dealt by any of their non-psychic hits this turn. Laviscus' Damage stat is increased by {[extraDmgPct]}% of his Outrage and his normal attacks deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each friendly Chaos character that increased his Outrage this turn. At the end of his turn or after Laviscus performs a normal attack, his Outrage resets.
RefusalToBeOutdone.name: Refusal to be Outdone

ReinforcedHiveNode.description: Every second round – starting from the first the Tyranid Warrior is in play – the Tyranid Warrior has +100% Armour and – if it has Block – 100% Block chance.
ReinforcedHiveNode.name: Reinforced Hive Node

Reinforcements.description: At the start of Sibyll Devine’s turn, {[nrOfSummons]} Cadian Guardsmen are summoned at the top of the map and immediately take a turn. Each time a friendly Cadian Guardsman is defeated, Sibyll Devine is dealt {[dmg]} Psychic Damage.
Reinforcements.name: Reinforcements!

RelentlessMarch.description: Gives +1 Movement to all friendly units that start their turn in an adjacent hex. Also repairs affected Mechanical units for {[hpToRepair]} Health.
RelentlessMarch.name: Relentless March

RelicBoltPistol.description: The relic bearer gains +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with melee attacks and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage with ranged attacks. These bonuses are doubled against Chaos or Xenos enemies.
RelicBoltPistol.name: Relic Bolt Pistol

RelicOfLostCadia.description: Friendly surrounding Imperial Summons have Final Vengeance. When the relic bearer is defeated, summons a Cadian Guardsman in its hex with {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.
RelicOfLostCadia.name: Relic of Lost Cadia

RelicPowerFist.description: The relic bearer's attacks that deal Power Damage have a {[chance]}% chance to Suppress and a {[chance_2]}% chance to Stun enemies targeted by them. These chances are doubled if the attack is an active ability.
RelicPowerFist.name: Relic Power Fist

ResurrectionOrb.description: Resurrects a random friendly Mechanical character in a free adjacent hex and additionally summons Necron Warriors in free adjacent hexes. Summons one Necron Warrior for each round that has passed and for each friendly Mechanical unit that was defeated in this battle, up to a maximum of {[maxSummons]} Necron Warriors. Units are resurrected and summoned with {[hpPct]}% Health. Necron Warrior’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ResurrectionOrb.name: Resurrection Orb

Reveal.description: An enemy within {[range]} hexes that is not Revealed and has defeated a friendly Aeldari unit this battle becomes Revealed for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. Friendly Aeldari that attack Revealed enemies ignore any hit reductions and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
Reveal.name: Reveal

RevitalizingMalignancy.description: Heals himself and all adjacent friendly units for {[hpToHeal]} Health, and an additional +{[hpToHeal_2]} Health to Chaos units. Imperial units do not receive any healing.
RevitalizingMalignancy.name: Revitalising Malignancy

RevoltinglyResilient.description: When attacked, each hit after the first {[nrOfHits]} hits in that same attack deals {[dmgPctReduction]}% less Damage than the previous hit. The first {[nrOfHits]} hits of each attack deal normal damage, the next hit 50% damage, the next hit 25%, etc.
RevoltinglyResilient.name: Revoltingly Resilient

RighteousRepugnance.description: Normal melee attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and to all enemy units adjacent to both the target and to Morvenn Vahl. When Morvenn Vahl defeats a unit with a melee attack, it has a {[chance]}% chance to count twice for Act of Faith.
RighteousRepugnance.name: Righteous Repugnance

RitesOfBattle.description: Adjacent friendly units gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage. Imperial units gain +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage instead.
RitesOfBattle.name: Rites of Battle

RitesOfMorkai.description: Baldr and all surrounding friendly non-mechanical units become Inspired for {[nrOfRounds]} round or until they are revived. The first time each inspired unit would be defeated, it is instead revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, unless Overkilled. Inspired units with Final Vengeance deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with all attacks. After using this ability, Baldr immediately performs a normal melee attack against an adjacent enemy.
RitesOfMorkai.name: Rites of Morkai

RitesOfRestoration.description: Heals herself and all adjacent friendly units for {[hpToHeal]} Health. Resurrects {[nrOfHeroes]} random friendly Imperial Character and up to {[nrOfSummons]} random friendly Imperial Summons that have been defeated in this battle. Resurrected units appear in free adjacent hexes with {[hp]} Health and are unable to act on this turn. Only affects non-Mechanical units.
RitesOfRestoration.name: Rites of Restoration

SabreOfSacrifice.description: When Dreir or Death Riders adjacent to Dreir are charging, their attacks Suppress their targets for 1 round. After charging and until the start of their next turn, they additionally have +{[extraArmor]} Armour for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle.
SabreOfSacrifice.name: Sabre of Sacrifice

SagaOfTheWarriorBorn.description: When charging, Ragnar scores {[extraHits]} additional hits and his critical hits deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. If Ragnar has defeated one or more enemy Characters this battle, friendly Space Wolves also gain this ability.
SagaOfTheWarriorBorn.name: Saga of the Warrior Born

SanctorumMissile.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to a target within range {[range]} and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all hexes adjacent to the target – with the exception of Morvenn Vahl's own hex, were she adjacent to the target.
SanctorumMissile.name: Sanctorum Missile

SanguinaryPriest.description: After moving, all adjacent friendly non-mechanical units regenerate {[hpToHeal]}-{[maxHpToHeal]} Health. If Nicodemus does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn.
SanguinaryPriest.name: Sanguinary Priest

SavageEchoes.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerate to an adjacent enemy unit. This attack deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each free hex adjacent to Cezare. If Cezare is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, he also regenerates {[hp]} Health after using this ability.
SavageEchoes.name: Savage Echoes

SavageKiller.description: When a Summon moves to or is summoned adjacent to Ulf, he immediately deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to it. Ulf will also perform this ability against any enemy that attempts to use an active ability while in a hex adjacent to him, in which case he deals his Damage before that unit's ability is activated.
SavageKiller.name: Savage Killer

SaviorProtocols.description: If a friendly adjacent T'au Empire unit is attacked, there is a {[chance]}% chance for each hit to be scored against this Drone instead of the original target. When moving, this Drone prioritises hexes adjacent to friendly T'au Empire units. When attacking, this Drone tries to prioritise enemies with a Markerlight.
SaviorProtocols.name: Saviour Protocols

ScarabHive.description: Summons 2 Scarab Swarms next to the target, whom they immediately attack using the Damage type Piercing. In any subsequent attack they use their normal damage type. Scarab Swarm’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ScarabHive.name: Scarab Hive

ScarabSummon.description: Summons another Scarab Swarm in a free adjacent hex, which then immediately takes a turn.
ScarabSummon.name: Scarab Summon

ScreamerInvocation.description: The first time there are no allied Daemons on the battlefield at the end of his turn, Abraxas summons {[nrOfSummons]} Screamers onto random hexes on the battlefield. When a friendly Daemon is defeated, Abraxas loses {[hp]} Health. As long as there are friendly Daemons on the battlefield, all incoming damage to Abraxas is reduced by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Screamer of Tzeentch stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
ScreamerInvocation.name: Screamer Invocation

ScytheOfDust.description: Mesophet does a mighty sweep with his scythe, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to all enemies in adjacent hexes.
ScytheOfDust.name: Scythe of Dust

ScythingTalons.description: Attacks an enemy in melee for {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage and any enemy units adjacent to that target and to the Tyranid Warrior take {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage. Double hits against Summons.
ScythingTalons.name: Scything Talons

SeekerMissileFrequencyLock.description: A target enemy unit within {[range]} receives a Markerlight until the end of Sho'syl's next turn. At the beginning of Sho'syl's next turn, if he is still in play, the target is hit by a Seeker Missile dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SeekerMissileFrequencyLock.name: Seeker Missile Frequency Lock

SelfRepairMechanism.description: Beginning with the end of round {[nrOfRounds]}, at the end of each of his turns, Belisarius Cawl repairs himself for {[hpToRepair]} Health for each level of Machine Vengeance he has.
SelfRepairMechanism.name: Self-Repair Mechanism

SelfRepairMechanismReworked.description: Beginning with the end of round {[nrOfRounds]}, at the end of each of his turns, Belisarius Cawl gains + {[extraArmor]} Armour for each level of Machine Vengeance he has.
SelfRepairMechanismReworked.name: Self-Repair Mechanism

SendInTheNextWave.description: Select a target within 2 hexes. Summon {[nrOfSummons]} Cadian Guardsmen plus one for each defeated friendly unit, who immediately appear and fire upon a target from random free hexes within range 2 of the target. The maximum number of Cadian Guardsmen this can summon is {[maxSummons]}. Cadian Guardsman’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SendInTheNextWave.name: Send In The Next Wave

SentinelDirectives.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]} and Suppresses it for 1 round. Cannot be used if there is an enemy adjacent to Sy-Gex. Using Sentinel Directives does not end Sy-Gex's turn and he can still enter Overwatch this turn, unless he performs a normal attack.
SentinelDirectives.name: Sentinel Directives

SereneUnifier.description: Aun'Shi grants himself, and adjacent friendly units a bonus based on the current round at the beginning of his turn. Friendly T'au Empire units within {[range]} hexes also receive this bonus. The bonus lasts until the start of the unit's next turn, even if Aun'Shi is defeated. The following Buffs are granted subsequently in each round: 1: Sense of Stone: units take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage 2: Zephyr's Grace: units receive +{[extraMovement]} Movement 3: Storm of Fire: units gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage After round 3, the cycle begins again and will continue to repeat until Aun'Shi is defeated.
SereneUnifier.name: Serene Unifier

ShieldOfFaith.description: When a friendly Mythic character Crits or attacks an enemy that is on a hex with Fire, it gains a Shield until the start of its next turn, unless it already has a shield. The shield's Health is {[shieldPct]}% of the affected character's maximum Health.
ShieldOfFaith.name: Shield of Faith

ShockAssault.description: Whenever Bellator attacks, any Inceptor adjacent to him also attacks eligible targets, dealing +{[extraDmg]} Damage for this attack.
ShockAssault.name: Shock Assault

Shrapnel.description: The Mortar Team's ranged attack deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to {[nrOfProjectiles]} random hexes adjacent to their target. Units hit are also Suppressed.
Shrapnel.name: Shrapnel

ShroudPsalm.description: Up to {[nrOfTargets]} other friendly units gain {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance and are affected by Shroud Psalm until the start of their next turn. Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour and normal attacks against them score -{[hitsReduction]} hits, to a minimum of 1.
ShroudPsalm.name: Shroud Psalm

SilentDeath.description: Jain Zar throws the Silent Death at an adjacent enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage to it and up to {[nrOfTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to each other, before returning to Jain Zar’s hands.
SilentDeath.name: Silent Death

Skullsmasher.description: Macer deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each {[hpPct]}% of his maximum Health he is currently missing. In addition, if Macer has defeated an enemy this battle, all enemies he attacks become Stunned.
Skullsmasher.name: Skullsmasher

SkyStrike.description: If Celestine has not moved, she targets an enemy unit on the battlefield that has a free adjacent hex, then moves adjacent to it and attacks it. The attack deals the same damage as her normal attack plus an additional +{[extraDmg]} Damage. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
SkyStrike.name: Sky Strike

SlashingDive.description: Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[0]]} Power Damage to first target, {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[1]]} Power Damage to the second, and {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[2]]} Power Damage to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it.
SlashingDive.name: Slashing Dive

SmashaEad.description: When he traverses 2 or more hexes during his turn, then Tanksmasha gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage for normal attacks and takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage until the start of his next turn.
SmashaEad.name: Smasha 'Ead

SolarAtomizer.description: Transfers all levels of Machine Vengeance from other friendly Mechanical units to Belisarius Cawl. Additionally Belisarius Cawl faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide. At the beginning of his next turn, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage to all enemies on affected hexes.
SolarAtomizer.name: Solar Atomizer

SorcerousFacade.description: Target a friendly Psyker. Until the beginning of Yazaghor's next turn both he and the target deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage with their normal attacks. Yazaghor performs a normal attack against the closest enemy unit, and then switches positions with the targeted Psyker. Note: this ability can only be used if Yazaghor has an enemy in range.
SorcerousFacade.name: Sorcerous Facade

SoulHunger.description: Enemy Psykers take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage when using Active abilities or Smite within {[range]} hexes from the Hive Tyrant. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SoulHunger.name: Soul Hunger

SpawnTermagants.description: Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} Termagants, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there. Termagant’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpawnTermagants.name: Spawn Termagants

SpawnTermagants2.description: Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} Termagants, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there. Termagant’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpawnTermagants2.name: Spawn Termagants

SpawnTermagants3.description: Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} Termagants, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there. Termagant’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpawnTermagants3.name: Spawn Termagants

SpecialIssueCombiMelta.description: Ramus' normal attacks are enhanced, based on the distance to his target: Attacks Suppress the target if it is exactly 3 hexes away from him. Attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter if the target is exactly 2 hexes away from him. Attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage if the target is in a surrounding hex.
SpecialIssueCombiMelta.name: Special-Issue Combi-Melta

SpiritLeech.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. If the target is Suppressed, deals an additional +{[extraDmg]} Damage, otherwise Suppresses it. The Neurothrope heals itself and friendly Tyranids adjacent to it for Health equal to {[hpToHealPct]}% of the total damage dealt with this ability. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SpiritLeech.name: Spirit Leech

SpiritualLeader.description: After moving, places a decoy on an empty adjacent hex. Then, if there are 2 or more decoys adjacent to Xybia, summons a Neophyte Hybrid on one adjacent decoy. If Xybia does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of her turn. Neophyte Hybrid stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpiritualLeader.name: Spiritual Leader

Split.description: When this unit gets defeated, it summons 2 Blue Horrors in adjacent hexes. Does not apply if Overkilled. Newly summoned Blue Horrors can immediately attack an enemy if summoned during the Pink Horror's turn, but cannot move until their next turn. Blue Horror's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
Split.name: Split

SporeMineLauncher.description: Summons a Spore Mine onto a free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy. Spore Mines have {[summonHp]} Health and deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage damage with Floating Death.
SporeMineLauncher.name: Spore Mine Launcher

SpotterReworked.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks. Affected units with Heavy Weapon deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage with ranged attacks instead.
SpotterReworked.name: Spotter

SquigHound.description: Friendly Grots ignore Battle Fatigue. Snotflogga's normal attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage. After attacking, if there are less than {[maxSummons]} friendly Grots on the battlefield, they summon a Grot adjacent to the target that immediately can attack. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
SquigHound.name: Squig Hound

SquigLaunchas.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an enemy unit that has at least {[nrOfUnits]} friendly Ork or {[nrOfUnits_2]} friendly units adjacent to it. Then, if the target has {[nrOfUnits_3]} friendly Orks or {[nrOfUnits_4]} friendly units adjacent to it, summons a Large Squig on a random free hex adjacent to the target. Large Squig stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SquigLaunchas.name: Squig Launchas

SquigMine.description: Marks a free hex on the battlefield and additionally {[nrOfTiles]} random free hexes within range {[range]} of the target hex. Until the start of the Rukkatrukk's next turn, the first time a marked hex is occupied by an enemy, that enemy takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage, and the mark is removed. When a friendly unit occupies an affected hex, it does not take damage, and the mark is removed. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SquigMine.name: Squig Mine

StaffOfStars.description: Hapthatra unleashes the full power of the Staff of Stars, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to an initial target and {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy Damage to all enemies adjacent to that target. Summons take double Damage.
StaffOfStars.name: Staff of Stars

StandVigil.description: Friendly surrounding units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage with attacks that are not normal attacks. If a friendly Adeptus Custodes uses an Active Ability, Stand Vigil affects all other friendly units within {[range]} hexes for 1 round.
StandVigil.name: Stand Vigil

SternguardFocus.description: Ramus performs a normal attack, using {[dmgPct]}% of his own Damage stat to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds. If Ramus uses this ability while adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel, then it can be used again in his next turn without cooldown. Using Fire Discipline does not end Ramus' turn and he can still enter Overwatch at the end of his turn, unless he performs another normal attack.
SternguardFocus.name: Fire Discipline

Stikkbomb.description: Throws a grenade at a target, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to the target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to units in hexes adjacent to the target. Range {[range]} and Indirect Fire applies.
Stikkbomb.name: Stikkbomb

StormOfFlensingBlades.description: Attacks an adjacent enemy twice in a row, as long as the Flayed One started the turn adjacent to it.
StormOfFlensingBlades.name: Storm of Flensing Blades

StormOfWrath.description: Deals 1x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a unit within 2 hexes and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} adjacent units. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
StormOfWrath.name: Storm Of Wrath

StormboyzStrike.description: In its first turn this unit flies into any free hex, instead of starting on its designated spawn point. There's a {[chance]}% chance it misses its designated hex and ends up in a random adjacent hex instead. This fly-in counts as a movement for Full Throttle.
StormboyzStrike.name: Stormboyz Strike

Stormcaller.description: Target an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. The target's hex and all adjacent hexes get covered in Ice. All enemies on hexes covered in Ice take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage. Flying enemies damaged this way get Stunned for 1 round. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Stormcaller.name: Stormcaller

StranglethornCannon.description: The Hive Tyrant attacks using its Stranglethorn Cannon, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to an initial target within {[range]} hexes. Any units adjacent to the target suffer {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage.
StranglethornCannon.name: Stranglethorn Cannon

StrikeFromTheShadows.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter to an enemy within range {[range]}. Until the end of Cyrus' next turn, all ranged attacks against the target ignore {[armorIgnored]} Armour. After using this ability, Cyrus may move, even if he already moved this turn.
StrikeFromTheShadows.name: Strike from the Shadows

StructuralAnalyser.description: Units hit by ranged attacks from Darkstrider receive a Markerlight for one round. Friendly units adjacent to Darkstrider deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks against targets with a Markerlight. Friendly T'au Empire units within 2 hexes of Darkstrider are also affected.
StructuralAnalyser.name: Structural Analyser

SummaryExecution.description: Friendly units with Battle Fatigue gain +{[extraDmg]} Damage. The first time a friendly unit would flee due to Battle Fatigue, it is executed instead and all other friendly units with the trait ignore it and gain an additional +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage.
SummaryExecution.name: Summary Execution

SupaCyborkBody.description: The relic bearer can be healed as well as repaired and additionally takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each adjacent enemy unit.
SupaCyborkBody.name: Supa-Cybork Body

Supercharge.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to a target enemy within range {[range]} and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Plasma Damage to up to two enemies in adjacent hexes behind the target, all with +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio. Until the beginning of Sarquael's next turn, any further hits that deal Plasma Damage against these units also have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio.
Supercharge.name: Supercharge

SupremeCommander.description: Summons up to {[nrOfSummons]}Cadian Guardsman in free adjacent hexes. All friendly Cadian Guardsmen within {[range]} hexes then immediately take a turn. If Colour Sergeant Kell is in play, summons an additional Cadian Guardsman and activation range is 3. Cadian Guardsman’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SupremeCommander.name: Supreme Commander

SwornProtector.description: When Lord Castellan Creed is first targeted in battle, Colour Sergeant Kell appears in a free adjacent hex. Any time Creed is attacked, Kell switches hexes with him and takes the Damage instead, if they are adjacent to each other. Kell’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SwornProtector.name: Sworn Protector

SynapticBacklash.description: Whenever the Tervigon sustains a Crit, friendly Termagants within {[range]} hexes are also dealt {[dmgPct]}% of that attack’s Damage.
SynapticBacklash.name: Synaptic Backlash

SynapticImperative.description: All friendly units adjacent to this unit have a {[chance]}% chance to be revived at {[hp]} Health when suffering lethal Damage, unless Overkilled. This can only happen once per unit per turn.
SynapticImperative.name: Synaptic Imperative

SynapticInsight.description: This unit's ranged attacks score +{[extraHit]} hits against targets that are within Synapse range or adjacent to another Tyranid.
SynapticInsight.name: Synaptic Insight

SynapticLinchpin.description: Whenever the Winged Prime, or another friendly unit with Synapse, performs a normal attack against an enemy and that enemy is not defeated, summons a Hormagaunt adjacent to the target, which immediately attacks the enemy. Cannot have more than {[maxSummons]} Hormagaunts summoned this way at the same time. Hormagaunt stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SynapticLinchpin.name: Synaptic Linchpin

TacticalPrecision.description: Attacks a targeted adjacent enemy. If Titus has charged that enemy this turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to it. This attack is always a Crit and deals an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. If Titus did not charge the targeted enemy this turn, he instead deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Chain Damage to all adjacent enemies. When Titus gets revived or resurrected and Tactical Precision has already been used, then Tactical Precision can be used again in this battle.
TacticalPrecision.name: Tactical Precision

TaintedNarthecium.description: An adjacent friendly Chaos unit that is defeated has a {[chance]}% chance to be revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health, even if Overkilled. Can only be triggered once per turn.
TaintedNarthecium.name: Tainted Narthecium

TalismanOfRage.description: Each time the relic bearer defeats an enemy with a melee attack, it counts twice for Blessings Of Khorne. The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each level of Blessings Of Khorne.
TalismanOfRage.name: Talisman of Rage

TalonOfHorus.description: When Abaddon performs a normal melee attack, he also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Abaddon.
TalonOfHorus.name: Talon of Horus

TalonsOfTheEmperor.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy unit. This attack deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each time a friendly Character has used an active ability this battle. If the target is a Psyker or Atlacoya is adjacent to a friendly Adeptus Custodes, this attack deals Direct Damage instead.
TalonsOfTheEmperor.name: Talons Of The Emperor

TargetLock.description: At the beginning of the Riptide's turn, it deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all enemy units with a Markerlight.
TargetLock.name: Target Lock

TargetingProtocols.description: Sets up to fire on {[nrOfTargets]} hexes. These hexes light up with light pillars and at the start of the Menhir's next turn any unit in those hexes is hit by an Annihilator Beam and is dealt {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage.
TargetingProtocols.name: Targeting Protocols

TerrifyingCrescendo.description: Shiron's ranged attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each time he Overkilled or would have Suppressed an enemy unit, up to a maximum of {[buffMaxLevel]} times.
TerrifyingCrescendo.name: Terrifying Crescendo

TerrorsLament.description: Adjacent enemy units deal -{[dmgReduction]} Damage and have -{[hitsReduction]} hits with melee attacks, to a minimum of 1.
TerrorsLament.name: Terror's Lament

TheArdentBlade.description: The first time each turn that Celestine defeats an enemy unit, she resurrects one of her Geminae Superia with {[hp]} Health in a free adjacent hex. If they cannot be resurrected, then one of them within {[range]} hexes takes an action instead.
TheArdentBlade.name: The Ardent Blade

TheBetrayer.description: After performing a normal attack, Khârn performs a second attack against an adjacent enemy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage. If Khârn has defeated an enemy this battle, at the start of his turn, he automatically moves up to {[range]} hexes towards the nearest unit and then deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Eviscerating Damage to an adjacent unit. Khârn prefers enemies for this automatic move and attack, but targets friendly units if no enemy is in range.
TheBetrayer.name: The Betrayer

TheBloodyHanded.description: Other friendly Aeldari units are Unstoppable and deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against enemies standing on Fire.
TheBloodyHanded.name: The Bloody Handed

TheEmperorsShield.description: Each hit scored by a melee attack against Lion El'Jonson increases his Block chance by +{[blockChance]}% until the end of this turn. Every time Lion El'Jonson blocks {[nrOfAttacks]} or more hits of a melee attack against him, he deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct to the attacker.
TheEmperorsShield.name: The Emperor's Shield

TheLantern.description: Conjures a miasma of pestilence in one of six directions that fills a 3x3 hex area adjacent to Mortarion. Enemy units hit by the miasma are Suppressed. At the beginning of Mortarion's next turn he fires The Lantern's beam in an arc over the affected area, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to each enemy unit in the area. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TheLantern.name: The Lantern

TheLionsWrath.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to an adjacent enemy unit and Taunts it for {[nrOfRounds]} round. At the beginning of his next turn, if the targeted unit is still adjacent to Lion El'Jonson, he deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Piercing to it. All attacks triggered by this ability have a {[chance]}% Chance to score a Crit with their second hit, even if the first hit did not score a Crit.
TheLionsWrath.name: The Lion's Wrath

TheQuickening.description: Targets a hex within movement range {[range]} that is neither occupied by an enemy nor by a friendly unit in Deep Strike. Mephiston moves onto that hex. If a friendly unit is on that hex, that unit moves to Mephiston's previous location. All Blood Angels moving this way perform a normal melee attack after they move, dealing {[dmgPct]}% of their own damage to a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage. Units moving this way do not trigger Overwatch or other movement related reactions.
TheQuickening.name: The Quickening

TheWailingDoomStrikes.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide and originating from the Avatar of Khaine on Fire, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage to all enemies on affected hexes.
TheWailingDoomStrikes.name: The Wailing Doom Strikes

TheWailingDoomSweeps.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets a cone of hexes in range 2 in front of it on Fire, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage to all enemies on affected hexes.
TheWailingDoomSweeps.name: The Wailing Doom Sweeps

TheWildHost.description: Reduces all incoming damage by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Aethana loses {[hp]} Health each time she is attacked. At the beginning of Aethana's turn, units on marked hexes take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage, and she marks all hexes of units that attacked her last turn. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TheWildHost.name: The Wild Host

TheWrathOfKhaineUnleashedReworked.description: At the beginning of the Avatar of Khaine's next turn, he deals Flame Damage to all enemies within {[range]} hexes, except enemies on healing hexes. This attack deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage per hit and scores {[nrOfHits]} hits against surrounding enemies, {[nrOfHits_2]} hits against enemies at range {[range_2]}, and {[nrOfHits_3]} hits against enemies at range {[range]}. Then all Fire in the affected area is extinguished, and all adjacent enemies are pushed one hex.
TheWrathOfKhaineUnleashedReworked.name: The Wrath of Khaine Unleashed

TheWrathfulDead.description: On each of his turns, {[nrOfSummons]} Poxwalkers spawn on the map in random free hexes, preferring hexes that are not adjacent to enemy Characters. The spawned Poxwalkers don't move on the turn they are summoned, but will attack a target in range if there is one. Any time a friendly unit is defeated, Corrodius also takes Direct Damage equal to {[healthPct]}% of the defeated unit's maximum Health.
TheWrathfulDead.name: The Wrathful Dead

ThriceBlessedConflagration.description: Targets a friendly unit on the battlefield. For {[nrOfRounds]} rounds, it deals +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage with ranged attacks against enemies on Fire hexes. Affected Adepta Sororitas units deal additional damage with all attacks instead. The Exorcist then deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies in the longest uninterrupted straight line originating from the targeted friendly unit. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round. Cost: {[munitionsCost]} munition. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ThriceBlessedConflagration.name: Thrice-Blessed Conflagration

ThunderousAssault.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to an adjacent enemy and pushes it one hex backwards. The target is Stunned for 1 round. Sword Brother Godswyl then moves into the vacated hex if able. Enemies defeated by this attack are always overkilled.
ThunderousAssault.name: Thunderous Assault

TimeFlux.description: At the beginning of his turn, Toth regenerates {[hpToHeal]} Health plus an additional amount equal to the Damage of the last hit he received in the last enemy turn. The total amount restored cannot exceed {[maxHpToHeal]} Health. When Toth moves, he leaves a time ghost behind on the hex he moved from. The time ghost vanishes if the hex becomes occupied by another unit or if the terrain becomes impassable (as with Broken Ice). The first time Toth dies each battle, if his time ghost is on the battlefield then he revives with {[hp]} Health remaining at its location. This works even if Toth is Overkilled.
TimeFlux.name: Time Flux

TimesplinterMantle.description: At the start of each turn, Thothmek and all friendly adjacent Mechanical units gain Timesplinter Mantle. Affected units take -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from the first attack made by a unit against them. After being attacked or at the end of the turn, the effect ends.
TimesplinterMantle.name: Timesplinter Mantle

TitanhammerSquad.description: Marks a free hex on the battlefield that is not adjacent to an enemy unit. Lysander and all friendly Terminator Armour units within {[range]} hexes of Lysander are healed for {[hpToHeal]} Health and block an additional +{[blockDmg]} Damage until the beginning of their next turn. If they have not moved in this turn, they can also move on or adjacent to the hex marked by this ability. Using Titanhammer Squad does not end Lysander's turn. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
TitanhammerSquad.name: Titanhammer Squad

ToughToKill.description: At the beginning of his turn, Dreir regenerates {[hpToHeal]} Health. All attacks against Dreir have -{[critChanceReduction]}% Crit Chance and deal -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage.
ToughToKill.name: Tough to Kill

TreasonOfTzeentch.description: Teleports an enemy character to another random hex and creates a copy of the character in its old location. The copy fights on the side of Magnus and has {[hpPct]}% of the original character's maximum Health. All other stats and ability levels are identical.
TreasonOfTzeentch.name: Treason of Tzeentch

TrophyTaker.description: Tarvakh's attacks against units that are at or below {[hpPct]}% of their maximum Health deal+{[extraDmg]} Damage and an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. His Crit chance is increased by {[extraCritChance]}% for each unit that he defeated this battle.
TrophyTaker.name: Trophy Taker

TunnelingHorror.description: This unit may use tunnelling to move. It is then removed from the battlefield and emerges in its chosen hex at the start of its next turn, pushing any unit in that hex aside. It is then able to immediately attack any adjacent enemy in melee.
TunnelingHorror.name: Tunnelling Horror

TwinSmartMissileSystem.description: Targets an enemy unit on the battlefield, then deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to each enemy unit that has a Markerlight. The target unit then receives a Markerlight for 2 rounds. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TwinSmartMissileSystem.name: Twin Smart Missile System

TwistedScience.description: Units healed by Hollan, other than himself, are affected by Twisted Science until they are defeated. Hollan can heal other unaffected units even if they are at full Health. Affected units immediately gain {[hp]} Health and their maximum Health increases by the same amount. If they are a Genestealer Cults unit, they also deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage while affected. Affected units cannot gain the effects of Twisted Science again.
TwistedScience.name: Twisted Science

TzeentchsFirestorm.description: Marks all hexes exactly {[range_2]} hexes away from Magnus in a ring around him. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemy units on marked hexes receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage. For the next 2 turns, the process repeats, reducing the ring radius by {[range]} and increasing hits to enemies in marked hexes by {[extraHits]} each turn. Magnus can move independently of the ring after the initial turn of casting. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TzeentchsFirestorm.name: Tzeentch's Firestorm

UnbreakableDuty.description: Ancient Thoread and all friendly units within {[range]} hexes receive -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage until the start of their next turn. If 2 or more friendly Imperial Characters are dead upon activation of this ability, Ancient Thoread gains {[extraHp]} extra Health and +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of the battle and immediately performs a normal attack against an adjacent enemy.
UnbreakableDuty.name: Unbreakable Duty

UnbridledCarnageReworked.description: At the end of Tanksmasha's turn, Grots and Explosive Oil Drums rain from the sky. If an Explosive Oil Drum gets destroyed, it explodes, damaging units on adjacent hexes. Tanksmasha loses {[hp]} Health from the explosion and all other characters take {[nrOfHits]} hit that inflicts Blast Damage equal to {[dmgPct]}% of the character's maximum Health. All affected Summons are destroyed.
UnbridledCarnageReworked.name: Clusta Bomma Precishun Strike

UnparalleledFerocity.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to all adjacent enemies, with a 100% Crit Chance againstSummons.
UnparalleledFerocity.name: Unparalleled Ferocity
