UnstoppableFerocity.description: Scores one additional hit when attacking an enemy Psyker. Scores one additional hit when charging.
UnstoppableFerocity.name: Unstoppable Ferocity

UnstoppableMomentumReworked.description: Charges in one of 6 directions and keeps moving in a straight line until he hits an obstacle or a Big Target. Any enemies hit by the charge take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage, increased by {[extraDmg]} Damage for each hex traversed from the starting hex to the enemy. Affected enemies get pushed and Suppressed for 1 round. A Big Target is Stunned for 1 round instead. Friendly units are also displaced, but take no damage or negative effects. Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round.
UnstoppableMomentumReworked.name: Unstoppable Momentum

UnwaveringSentinel.description: During each enemy turn, after Tyrith is attacked and the attacker is within range {[range]}, she deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to the attacker. If there is an enemy adjacent to Tyrith, the range of this ability is reduced to 1.
UnwaveringSentinel.name: Unwavering Sentinel

ValkyrieStrike.description: Calls in an air strike on a target hex anywhere on the battlefield, which gets marked with red smoke. After one round, the target hex and two random surrounding hexes are hit with Hellstrike Missiles, each dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ValkyrieStrike.name: Valkyrie Strike

VengeanceForTheOmnissiah.description: Whenever an adjacent friendly Mechanical is defeated, the Tech-Priest Enginseer gains {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance.
VengeanceForTheOmnissiah.name: Vengeance for the Omnissiah

VexillaMagnifica.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent enemy target and an additional adjacent enemy unit. Both enemies are Stunned for 1 round, and Aesoth receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds.
VexillaMagnifica.name: Vexilla Magnifica

VigilanceEternal.description: Targets an enemy unit that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} of Tyrith or is already on a hex adjacent to Tyrith. She then moves to the free hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the targeted unit. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds. Using Vigilance Eternal does not end Tyrith's turn.
VigilanceEternal.name: Vigilance Eternal

VisionsOfHeresy.description: After performing a normal attack, Lucien performs a second attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage. If Lucien is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, all of his attacks have +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio.
VisionsOfHeresy.name: Visions of Heresy

Vitarus.description: The hexes of each enemy hit by Mephiston's normal melee attack or by Fury of the Ancients are set on Fire. If these attacks hit enemies on hexes with Fire, they deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and extinguish the Fire.
Vitarus.name: Vitarus

Volatile.description: If this unit is Overkilled it deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to all adjacent tiles. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Volatile.name: Volatile

VoltagheistField.description: If Health is restored to this unit, the amount restored is reduced by {[healthPct]}% and it then scores +{[extraHit]} hit with normal attacks until the end of its turn.
VoltagheistField.name: Voltagheist Field

VolummsMasterArtifice.description: After Vynn or friendly E-COGs have performed +{[nrOfRepairs]} repairs, Vynn heals for {[hpToHeal]} Health and can use his active ability again.
VolummsMasterArtifice.name: Vôlumm's Master Artifice

VulnerableToFlameAndBlast.description: Each time this unit is dealt Flame Damage or Blast Damage, it loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done. This unit takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from hits that do not deal Flame Damage or Blast Damage.
VulnerableToFlameAndBlast.name: Vulnerable to Flame and Blast

VulnerableToMelee.description: Each time this unit is dealt Damage by a Melee attack, it loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done. This unit takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from attacks that are not Melee attacks.
VulnerableToMelee.name: Vulnerable to Melee

Waaagh.description: If Boss Gulgortz has not moved, he summons {[nrOfSummons]} Ork Boyz in free adjacent hexes. Until the end of this turn, all friendly Orks and friendly units adjacent to Boss Gulgortz gain +{[extraMovement]} Movement and their normal melee attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and score an additional hit. Boss Gulgortz then charges a targeted enemy in movement range, performing a normal melee attack against it. All friendly Ork Boyz take a turn. Ork Boyz' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
Waaagh.name: Waaagh!

WallOfMirrors.description: If the Stealth Battlesuit has not moved, it disappears from its current hex and reappears on a free hex on the battlefield from which it can perform a normal ranged attack against an enemy that has a Markerlight. This attack has +{[extraPierce]}% Pierce Ratio.
WallOfMirrors.name: Wall of Mirrors

WarConstruct.description: For 1 round, if there is no enemy adjacent to the Wraithguard, it shoots back at each enemy within range that attacks it or a friendly adjacent Aeldari.
WarConstruct.name: War Construct

WarHowl.description: If Ragnar has not moved, he and all friendly Characters that don't have a normal ranged attack gain Unstoppable until the end of this turn. Additionally, their normal melee attacks have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage until the end of this turn. Using War Howl does not end Ragnar's turn.
WarHowl.name: War Howl

WatchedOver.description: Adjacent friendly units take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Psychic Damage from enemy attacks and if they have a Block chance, that Block Chance is increased by +{[blockChance]}%. Enemy Psykers will not hit an additional unit with their normal ranged attacks when attacking units that are adjacent to a Watcher in the Dark.
WatchedOver.name: Watched Over

WayOfTheShortBlade.description: Normal ranged attacks of other friendly Characters within {[range]} hexes against enemies that are adjacent to a friendly Character ignore {[armorIgnored]} Armour and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. Commander Farsight and other friendly T'au Empire Characters within {[range]} hexes that perform a melee attack immediately perform a normal ranged attack against the same unit, even if they are adjacent to it.
WayOfTheShortBlade.name: Way of the Short Blade

WeakerRearArmour.description: If enemies are inside the rear arc of the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank, their attacks have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance against it.
WeakerRearArmour.name: Weaker Rear Armour

WhipcoilBody.description: This unit takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from melee attacks.
WhipcoilBody.name: Whipcoil Body

WhisperingWeb.description: When Lhykhis performs a normal ranged attack against an enemy, that enemy is affected by Whispering Web until Lhykhis is defeated or performs a normal ranged attack against a different unit. When a friendly character attacks an affected enemy, each hit in the same attack deals +{[extraDmg]} more Damage than the previous hit.
WhisperingWeb.name: Whispering Web

WireweaveNet.description: The first time Calandis is targeted by a normal melee attack during the enemy's turn, the attacker immediately takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage. If the attacker is eliminated, their melee attack is not executed.
WireweaveNet.name: Wireweave Net

WisdomOfTheAncients.description: Friendly Mythic characters take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage if they are adjacent to Galatian or a friendly Mythic character.
WisdomOfTheAncients.name: Wisdom of the Ancients

Wraithcannon.description: When performing a ranged attack, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to an enemy behind the target.
Wraithcannon.name: Wraithcannon

WrathfulDevotion.description: When Wrask arrives from Deep Strike or defeats an enemy in melee, he and adjacent friendly Chaos units gain a Shield with {[shieldHp]} Health for 1 round.
WrathfulDevotion.name: Wrathful Devotion

WyrdmakersHelm.description: During his turn, each time Baldr or an adjacent friendly unit gets healed for the first time this turn, Baldr immediately performs a normal melee attack. These attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and add Ice to the target's hex.
WyrdmakersHelm.name: Wyrdmaker's Helm
